tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /snyan ngag gi bstan bcos chen po me long la 'jug pa'i bshad sbyar daṇ+ḍi'i dgongs rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /snyan ngag gi bstan bcos chen po me long la 'jug pa'i bshad sbyar daṇ+ḍi'i dgongs rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// snyan ngag gi bstan bcos chen po me long la 'jug pa'i bshad sbyar daṇ+ḍi'i dgongs rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// dzayen+d+rasaukṛt+yadz+nyādzālanaidhiḥ birolitādit+yadz+walaḥpaṇaikaṃ / ༄༅// rgyal dbang mkhyen pa'i chu mtsho legs byas kyis// bsrubs skyes nyi ma 'bar ba'i gdengs ka nas/// / pradz+nyās+yasaṃmūṭamaran+dhakaraḥ sedharas+yaṃtsalatenarak+ṣa/// / ༄༅// rmongs pa'i mun pa gsod rtags shes rab kyi// ral gri'i 'khri shing g.yo ba des srungs shig/ 1 // rūpapradz+nyāswayarādzaparashan+tabhapaḥ kān+tatsaruṃhardaproḍakhātaṃprayubamadabadz+ridzinaḥrāgasarba/// / rdul bral shes rab mchog gi rang gzugs srid dang zhi ba'i mtshar sdug gi / snying por phyung ba'i lang tshos rab dregs rgyal rnams rdo rje'i chags pa la// saṃketaṃ.aupāla.udaragulaitam+buḥbyūdarat+naḥ dharmās+yadewiswaramadhurawāgīn+d+ra.āliṅgakaṇ+ṭhaḥ // sbyor ba'i brda thabs rin chen rgyud mangs phang par bkod la sen 'debs pa'i// "$ snyan 'gyur chos kyi dbyangs su 'bab pa ngag dbang lha mos mgrin 'khyud cig / thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug chen po'i dbyings su dag pa'i rang bzhin pha mtha' bral ba'i dngos/ rnam pa thams cad mngon sum mkhyen pa'i ye shes me long shes bya'i chos kun rtag tu 'char// cha shas res kyang rmongs chen 'khor ba'i mun pa 'jig mkhas ngag rnams kun gyi dbang phyug tu// 'phags pa'i sangs rgyas snang ba'i bdag nyid rdo rje'i slob dpon gzugs su bstan la dang bas 'dud/ 3 /mgon de'i gsung gi gsang ba ma la ya// las 'khrungs dpal gyi dum bu kun dga'i dri// rnam par rgyas pas sa gsum gdung 'phrog pa// lo chen ljon pa'i dbang por snying nas dad/ 4 /rnam 'dren de dag gsung gi gaṅgā che// mang thos ral pa'i nags mthar dus ring du// 'khyil 'di legs bshad yan lag brgyad ldan phyir// gzur gnas mkhas kun mchod pa'i yon du 'os/ 5 /dbyangs can ngag la zhugs pas dka' ba'i gnas// mtha' dag smig rgyu'i mdud ltar rang grol tshe// legs bshad nyams brgya rdzogs pa'i snyan 'gyur glu// len pas lam 'dir kho bo skal bzang snyam//

6 rmongs pa'i mun 'phrog 'khor ba'i gdung sel gnyen// 'jig rten kun la dga' bskyed grags pa'i gter// chos rab gsal byed byang chub snying po'i lam// ston nus snyan tshig zla ba gsar pa bzhin// 7 mngon 'dod mchog gi bzhin rgyas lus phra ma// don sgra gab pa'i tshig sbyor rgyan mtshar bos// yang dag spud pa'i rnam bshad mai na kaḥ /skyon bral sgeg pa'i gar ni yid 'ong byed// 8 rang bzhin gyis grub rnam dpyod a mra'i tshal// 'jam mgon gsung gi 'o rgyun gyis bcus pas// dpyad gsum rnam par dag pa bdud rtsi'i 'bras// yongs su smin pa'i bcud 'di myang bar rigs// 9 gzhung don 'khyog por mi 'grel zhing*// dgag sgrub rnyog mas ma bslad par// daṇ+ḍi'i bzhed dgongs 'khrul med du// drang por bsrang ba bdag gi las// 10 de phyir legs bshad rin po che'i// gtsug rgyan dri med 'od 'bar ba// skal bzang legs bris bu kun gyi// zur phud rgyan du gus pas longs// 11 de yang byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam 'khri shing gi yal 'dab dgu bcu rtsa gcig pa las/ mthong dang ma mthong bde la lam ni legs bshad kyis gsal sgron me lta bur skyod// legs bshad bdud rtsi'i ro ni nyams myong ldan pas mchog tu dga' ba'i char dag 'bebs// legs bshad don gnyer yul la gnyer bya kun mkhyen dag kyang don gnyer nyid du 'gyur// de slad dam pa rnams la legs bshad dang mtshungs dga' ba ci yang yod ma yin// zhes gsungs pa dang rjes su 'brel bar legs par bshad pa'i gtam gyi phreng bas rnam dpyod dang ldan pa'i snyan shal mdzes par byed pa ni mchog tu rigs par mthong la/ de ltar yang*/ zhi ba lhas/ sngon chad ma byung ba ni 'dir brjod min// sdeb sbyor mkhas pa'ang bdag la yod min te// de phyir gzhan don bsam pa bdag la med// rang gi yid la bsgom phyir ngas 'di brtsams// zhes gsungs pa bzhin// sngon du byung ba'i rgya bod kyi mkhas mchog rnams kyi gsung rgyun las brtsams te cung zhig gleng na/

bdag cag gi ston pa mchog gi bstan pa 'di la/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i grong khyer chen por 'jug pa'i sgo 'phar bla na med pa ni shes bya rig pa'i gnas lnga ste/ mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' rig pa'i dngos po lnga ma bslabs na ni nam du yang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thob par mi nus so// de bas na bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba'i phyir rig pa'i dngos po lnga bslab par bya'o zhes dang*/ rgyal tshab chen po ma pham pas/ rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la brtson par ma byas na// 'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen nyid thob mi 'gyur// de bas gzhan dag tshar gcad rjes su gzung phyir dang*// bdag nyid kun shes bya phyir de la de brtson bya// zhes dang*/ sa paṇ+ḍi tas/ rang blo shes bya'i gnas la ma sbyangs na// thams cad mkhyen pa nam mkha'i mtha' ltar ring*// de ltar dgongs nas rgyal dang rgyal sras kyis// shes bya'i gnas kun sbyangs zhes legs par gsungs// zhes gsungs pa 'di dag ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo/ rang gzhan gyi don gnyis 'byung ba'i gzhi/ 'phral yun gyi legs pa thams cad kyi 'byung khungs ston pa'i gsung yin te/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po 'dir sems can rnams sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba la longs su spyod pa'i rgyu ni/ 'jig lta dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i ma rig pa kho na yin/ de spong byed kyi gnyen po rig pa'i ye shes/ rig pa de 'phel bar bya ba'i thabs su phyi nang gi rig pa'i gnas ji snyed cig 'byung ba kun kyang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams thabs la mkhas shing thugs rje che bas/ ci rigs par dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas ma rig pa 'joms byed kyi thabs su bstan pa yin/ de la shes bya'i gnas bsam gyis mi khyab cing*/ de thams cad kyi don phyin ci ma log par shes pa ni mkhas pa'i mchog

bye brag gang la sbyangs shing bslabs pa'i don shes pa de yang de nyid la mkhas pa zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro zhing ming 'thob ste/ mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgor/ mkhas gang shes bya'i de kho na// ji bzhin rtogs pa yin par 'dod// bye brag sbyangs pa'i don shes pa// de yang de la mkhas zhes bya// zhes gsungs pa yin/ mkhas pas bslab par bya ba'i yul ni/ sgra tshad/ bzo gso/ nang don rig pa ste gnas chen po lnga/ gzhan yang 'dul ba lung gi ma'i rnam 'byed kyi dbur/ 'phags pa 'od srungs chen po'i gtam rgyud las brtsams te/ rig pa'i gnas bco brgyad la yang mkhas par gyur pa 'di lta ste/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud dang*/ cho ga zhib mo dang*/ gtan tshigs kyi rig pa dang*/ rig byed dang*/ brda sprod pa dang*/ sgra nges par sbyor ba dang*/ shes gsal dang*/ nges pa'i tshig dang*/ sdeb sbyor mkhas pa dang*/ skar ma'i rig pa dang*/ rtogs byed kyi rig pa dang*/ chur lhung gi rig pa dang*/ cher spyod kyi rig pa dang*/ 'jig rten rgyang 'phen pa'i rig pa dang*/ bye brag pa'i rig pa dang*/ rgyud drug cu pa dang*/ khyur mid kyi rig pa dang*/ gnas 'dug gi rig pa dang*/ rig pa'i gnas bco brgyad po 'di dag la blo shin tu rno bar gyur to zhes dang*/ mdzod rang 'grel las/ rol mo 'khrig thabs 'tsho rtsis grangs dang sgra// gso bskyed chos lugs bzo 'phongs gtan tshigs dang*// rnal 'byor thos pa dran pa skar ma'i dpyad// rtsis mig 'phrul 'khor sngon rabs sngon byung rig /'di dag rig pa'i gnas chen bco brgyad yin// zhes dang*/ skyes rabs rgya cher 'grel du slob dpon rat+na kīrtis/ rig pa'i gnas bco brgyad 'di lta ste/ rol mo dang*/ 'khrig thabs dang*/ 'tsho rtsis dang*/ grangs can dang*/ sgra dang*/ gso ba'i dpyad dang*/ bzo dang*/ 'phong dpyad dang*/ gtan tshigs kyi sbyor ba dang*/ rnal 'byor thos shing dran pa dang*/ skar ma'i dpyad dang*/

rtsis dang*/ mig 'phrul dang*/ sngon gyi rabs dang*/ de bzhin du bye brag pa dang*/ de bzhin gyi phreng ba dang*/ rig pa'i bstan bcos yongs su btags pa'o zhes cung mi 'dra bar bshad pa dag dang*/ lung phran tshegs kyi 'grel ba slob dpon tshul khrims bskyangs kyis mdzad par/ rol mo'i mtshan nyid sgyu ma dang*// 'gyed stobs dang ni me tog las// dmag rnams dang ni bdag nyid shes// g.yos su bya ba rnam par nges// tshong dang nor ni bsgyur ba dang*// rgyan dang lhag rtsis bcud kyis len// 'phrul 'khor sbyor dang dri ba dang*// 'phong dpyad dang ni che sbyor sgra// yi ge dang ni khwa skad dang*// rang rang bzo dang mtshon rnams brtag /gcod thabs dang ni sog le dang*// phub rnams skor bar byed pa dang*/ song dang 'ong ba shes pa dang*// gzhi yi mtshan nyid shes pa dang*// mdung dang rdo rje brtag pa dang*// lder so dag gi mtshan nyid dang*// zug rngu 'byin dang mig 'phrul dang*// bha ra ta yi bstan bcos shes// bcing dang khang pa brtsegs ma dang*// de bzhin rdo rje 'phang ba dang*// yan lag mnye dang mo 'debs dang*// de bzhin chu ni kun 'dzin dang*// dung gi sgra dang sdeb sbyor dang*// grong rdal dang ni glegs 'dra dang*// mtshan mo chom rkun shes pa dang*// byis pa rnams ni gso ba dang*// mi rnams gnyid kyis log pa dang*// sgo lcags dbye bar bya ba dang*// sgra dang sa rtog byed pa dang*// skyes pa bud med rta dang ni// glang po'i mtshan nyid gar slob dang*// 'byung po dag ni gso ba dang*// zangs ma mkhar ba gser dag dang*// shing dang dung gi ming shes dang*// ri mo tshon dang so dag gi /las rnams de dag go rim bzhin// skar ma'i mtshan nyid shes pa dang*// mtshan ma shes pa nyid dang yang*// nges pa'i tshig gi gzhung rnams kyis// sgyu rtsal drug cu rtsa bzhir shes// zhes dang*/ bye brag rtogs byed du/

bzo la sogs par gtogs pa sum cu/ rol mo'i bye brag bco brgyad/ glu dbyangs kyi nges pa bdun/ gar gyi cha byed dgu'o// de las bzo la sogs par gtogs pa sum cu ni/ yi ge lag rtsis/ grangs/ rtsis chen/ thor tshugs/ gom stabs/ lcags kyus bsgyur thabs/ ral gri'i thabs/ zhags pa gdab pa/ mda' bo che 'phen pa/ mdun du bsnur ba/ phyir bsnur ba/ bcad pa/ dral ba/ dbug pa/ rgyang nas 'phog pa/ sgra grag par 'phog pa/ gnad du 'phog pa/ mi tshor bar 'phog pa/ tshabs che ba/ mchongs pa/ gyad kyi 'dzin stangs/ bang*/ brkyal/ brgal ba/ glang po che'i gnyar zhon pa/ rta la zhon pa/ shing rta'i thabs/ mda' gzhu/ gyad stobs dang sum cu'o// rol mo'i bye brag bco brgyad ni/ bro/ rnga bo che/ rdza rnga/ rnga phran/ rnga chen po/ 'khar rnga/ pi wang rgyud gcig pa/ rdza rnga kha gcig pa/ lcags kyi sil khrol/ 'khar ba'i sil khrol/ pi wang rgyud gsum pa/ rnga mu kun+da/ sil snyan glu dbyangs dang bstun pa/ pheg rdob/ rol mo'i sgra/ pi wang*/ gling bu dang bco brgyad do// glu dbyangs kyi nges pa bdun ni/ bar ma/ drang srong*/ sa 'dzin/ drug ldan/ lnga pa/ blo gsal/ 'khor nyan dang bdun no// gar gyi cha byad dgu ni/ sgeg pa/ dpa' ba/ mi sdug pa/ drag shul/ bzhad gad/ 'jigs rung*/ snying rje/ rngam pa/ zhi ba dang dgu'o zhes 'byung ba'i sgyu rtsal drug cu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa rnam grangs mang por bshad pa dag kyang rig pa'i gnas chen lnga po 'dir ci rigs par 'dus so zhes ston par bzhed nas/ mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo las/ de yul brda sprod rtog ge dang*// 'tsho ba phyi nang rig ces bya// gzhan las gzhan dag rnam bshad pa// 'di yi nang du 'dus zhes bya// zhes gsungs par 'dug de las sgra dang tshad mas tshig don la 'khrul pa tshar gcod/ bzo dang gso bas gdul bya spyi dang bye brag rjes su 'dzin/ nang don rig pas bdag nyid kun mkhyen bsgrub pa'i lam gyi rnam pa kun shes par byed pas na/

tshar bcad/ rjes 'dzin/ kun mkhyen gyi rig gnas gsum du yang 'dus par/ rgyan gyi lung*/ de bas gzhan dag tshar gcad rjes su gzung phyir dang*// bdag nyid kun shes bya phyir de la de brtson bya// zhes pa'i lung gis gsal ba yin/ de las nang rig sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa ni bstan pa la zhugs pa kho na'i khyad par gyi chos yin pas thun mong ma yin pa dang*/ gzhan bzhi phyi nang kun gyi thun mong du bslab bya yin pas thun mong ba'i rig gnas su yang bzhag de dag kyang phyi rol pa rnams ni rnyed grags bkur sti sogs 'phral bde don gnyer gyi bsam pas 'jug la/ nang pa'i yang rigs can gsum gyi gang zag mtha' dag nang rig la theg pa gsum gyi byang chub don gnyer gyi bsam pas 'jug par mthun la/ lhag ma bzhi la nyan rang rnams phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad pa dang*/ rang gi grags pa bsgrags pa sogs gnas skabs kyi dgos pa 'ga' zhig gi phyir 'jug gi gzhan don du rdzogs byang gi bsam pas 'jug pa ni med do// theg chen la zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni/ rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po sgrub pa'i slad du shes bya'i gnas kun la 'jug cing bslab par bya ba yin te/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ rgyal sras rnams kyis mi bslab pa'i// dngos de gang yang yod ma yin// de ltar gnas pa'i mkhas pa la// bsod nams mi 'gyur gang yang med// ces 'byung ba lags kyang*/ deng sang ci rigs kyi bsam blo la/ spyir gyi rig gnas la slob pa ni grags 'dod langs pa'am mi tshe phyid thabs tsam yin la/ bye brag mu stegs dang thun mong du gyur cing khyim pas bslab par bya rgyu'i rig gnas bzhi po de 'drar sbyang ba ni ngal ba don med 'ba' zhig go snyam sems pa dang*/ de bas kyang blo chung ba kha cig gzhung lugs chen po la slob pa'i gtam thos na dug sbrul gyis gla rtsi'i dri tshor ba ltar 'jigs sems dang sdang sems mnyam du 'char zhing cha bsdus lad pa'i rig pa thar thor dpe bral gyi yon tan du bsgom pa'i rigs gcig dang*/

yang 'ga' zhig thos pa rgya chen po la skyon du 'dzin/ zhe 'dod mun sgom la gtad pa'ang snang bas de dag la smras pa/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob bya dmigs yul du bzhag nas/ de nyid kyi rgyur ci yang mi slob pa'i mun sgom zhig khas len pa ni/ dper na sa bon bra bo la 'bras bu sā lu 'dod pa dang 'dra ste/ rdo rje snying 'grel las/ rgyu 'drar de las skye ba yi// 'bras bu thams cad du mthong gi /ko ṭa pa yi sa bon las// sā lu 'bras bu 'byung ba med// ces dang*/ klu sgrub zhabs kyis/ de 'dra'i sa bon thams cad las// rgyu dang 'dra ba'i 'bras bu 'byung*// sa bon med par 'bras yod pa// shes ldan gang gis bsgrub par nus// zhes rgyu rigs 'dra las 'bras bu rigs 'dra 'byung ba'i tshul 'di ni 'jig rten gyi lugs dang yang mthun la/ chos rje rgya ras pas rten 'brel gyi chos skor las/ thos pa rgya cher bya long med pa'i sgom chen pas kyang*/ shes bya dang shes par byed mkhan kun la mos par bya/ rjes su yi rang bar byed/ tha na mgar ba yan chad la kho'i tho ba sogs lag par bzung*/ 'di lta bu la'ang mkhas par gyur cig ces smon lam 'debs/ rten 'brel bsgrigs par bshad 'dug de phyir/ rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa 'di// thams cad mkhyen pa'i khyad chos yin// ma bslabs pa las kun mkhyen du// 'gro na rgyu 'bras ga la bden// gsung ba de byung bar gda'/ rigs lam che ba cig yin pas kho bo tshad ma la gus mod khyed la smra na/ phyogs kyi glang pos kun btus las/ tshad ma dang gzhal bya nye bar brjod pa nyid kyis mu stegs pa'i 'dod pa snying po med pa'i phyir/ der zhen pa rnams ldog pa'i don du 'di brtsams pa yin gyi/ 'di tsam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la gzhug pa'i don du ni ma yin te/ rtog ge'i yul ma yin pa'i phyir ro zhes dang*/

jo bo rjes/ mngon sum rjes dpag dgos pa med// mu stegs rgol ba bzlog pa'i phyir// mkhas pa rnams kyis byas pa yin// zhes gsungs mod/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma'i drin las/ bod 'dir mu stegs kyi rgol ba yang med na/ de bzlog thabs kyis ci bya/ bsdus sud ni bod pa'i blo gros sgo 'byed du/ phywa ba chos seng gi brtsams chos yin gyi gzhung lugs kyi khag med do zer ba byung tshe lan du 'os pa smra shes na mkhas pa'o// deng sang thos sgom gnyis 'gal ba ltag sprod du bzung nas/ thos pa med pa'i bsgom pa ni// lag rdum brag la 'dzeg pa 'dra// zhes sogs kyi lung drangs nas sgom chen la 'dzer/ la las kha bshad stong pa'i 'phyor mgron des// rkyen nyon mongs thul bar dka' mor gda'/ zhes sogs lung 'dren dang bcas thos bsam pa la kha zer mod kyi/ phyogs gnyis kas kyang mdo sde rgyan gyi/ de ltar bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa gang yin de yang don med min// de ltar rnal 'byor can gyi sgom pa gang yin de yang don med min// gal te thos pa tsam gyis don mthong 'gyur na sgom pa don med 'gyur// gal te ma thos par yang sgom 'jug 'gyur na bstan pa don med 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa'i don la ji mi snyam pa'i blo gros 'chal bar song 'dug de bas na/ sangs rgyas dbyig gnyen zhabs kyis mngon pa mdzod du/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas// sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor// zhes gsungs pa'i tshig don 'di nyid snying gi thig ler bzung nas thos bsam sgom gsum 'gal med du nyams su len pa ni mkhas pa yin te/ skyes rabs las/ thos pa'i rjes 'jug sgrub la nges par sbyor// skye ba'i rdzong las tshegs chung thar bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs/ de ltar 'phros don 'ga' zhig brjod nas/ skabs don/ mkhas pas 'jug cing shes par bya ba'i gnas de dag las thog ma nyid du 'jug cing bslab par bya ba ci zhig ce na/

klu sgrub zhabs kyis/ tha snyad la ni ma brten par// dam pa'i don ni bstan mi nus// dam pa'i don ni ma rtogs par// mya ngan 'das pa thob mi 'gyur// zhes don dam pa'i gnas lugs rtogs par byed pa'ang brda dang tha snyad la brten dgos shing*/ de yang rjod byed yang dag pa la brten nas brjod bya phyin ci ma log par khong du chud par byed pa'i thabs brda sprod kyi gzhung la bslab dgos pa grub/ de nyid kyi nang tshan la/ rig gnas chung ba lnga ste/ dbye gzhi sgra'i steng du/ dbye ngo snyan ngag mngon brjod/ sdeb sbyor/ zlos gar bzhi bsnan pas rig gnas chung ba lnga'am/ tha snyad rig pa'i gnas lngar yang grags/ de lnga po'i dgos pa'i dbang du byas nas/ sgra shes na don la mi rmongs/ snyan ngag shes na tshig rgyan la mi rmongs/ mngon brjod shes na ming la mi rmongs/ sdeb sbyor shes na tshigs bcad la mi rmongs/ zlos gar shes na skad rigs la mi rmongs zhes snga rabs pa kun la rlung ltar du grags shing*/ zlos gar shes na skad rigs la mi rmongs pa'i don yang*/ rgya gar gyi yul gru chen po rnams su zlos gar sna tshogs pa byed pa'i tshe/ mdo 'dzin pa dang*/ chas su 'jug pa dang*/ bzhad gad mkhan dang*/ rol mo pa sogs kyis tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pa lha'i cha lugs 'dzin pa de dag saṃskṛta'i skad du gtam smra zhing glu blang ba dang*/ ma ga dha la sogs mi'i cha lugs 'dzin pa dang*/ bud med kyi brjod pa phal che ba prakṛta'i skad dang*/ bzhad gad mkhan sogs kyi skabs btsal ba dang*/ co 'dri gleng bslang phal cher a wa bh+raṃ sha ste zur chag pa dang*/ 'byung po ro langs sogs mi ma yin pa dag gi cha lugs 'dzin pa rnams ni/ pi shā tsi sha za'i skad du smra bas zlos gar shes na skad rigs la mi rmongs pa'i don yin gsungs/ lo chen bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sde la sogs pas/ sgra ni rig gnas che ba yin na/ che chung gnyis gzhi gcig la 'gal bas 'thad pa ma yin la/

des na chung ba lnga ni/ snyan ngag mngon brjod/ sdeb sbyor/ zlos gar/ rtsis kyi rig pa ste lngar nges so zhes dang*/ rtsis shes na grangs kyi gnas gzhan la mi rmongs zhes bzhed do// 'di dang phyogs mthun mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud las/ byang chub sems dpa' sems can 'dun par bya ba'i phyir gzhan dag la snyan par dngags pa'i bstan bcos dang*/ ming gcig nyid don du mar 'jug pa dang*/ don gcig nyid kyang ming gi rnam grangs du mas mngon par brjod pa'i bstan bcos dang*/ lci ba dang yang ba'i yi ge bsgyur ba dang spel ba'i sgo nas tshigs su bcad pa sdeb pa'i bstan bcos dang*/ mdo 'dzin pa dang*/ bzhad gad dang*/ skad du ma gzhan du bsgyur bas 'gro ba dga' bar byed pa zlos gar gyi bstan bcos dang*/ grangs kyi rig pas gzhal te ngo mtshar bar ston pa rtsis kyi bstan bcos rnams kyang bslab par bya ste/ byang chub sems dpa' de ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod pa'i phyir ro zhes 'byung la/ de las snyan tshig gi rig pa 'di bslab par bya ba'i gnas mchog tu gces pa zhig yin te/ nang don rig pa'i gsung rab rnams kyang snyan ngag gi gzugs kho nar gnas shing*/ rig gnas gzhan kun la'ang 'di nyid 'jug pas shes bya kun la blta ba'i mig 'bras lta bu dang*/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis/ gang phyir mkhas pa'i las gsum las// rtsod 'chad ngag la ma nges pa// srid phyir mi 'khrul rtsom pa ste// zhes mkhas pa'i bya ba gsum gyi mchog rtsom pa bzang ngan/ snyan ngag shes mi shes kyi rjes su 'gro ldog byed la/ brjod tshul tha mal ba las khyad par du gyur pa'i tshig nyams kyis gdul bya yi rangs nas gdams ngag la mthun par 'dzin pa 'byung zhing*/ mkhas pa'i grags pa dkar po srid mthar 'phro ba sogs dgos pa rgya cher yod de/ rtogs brjod rin po che dpag bsam 'khri shing las/ mkhas pa nyid ni med na blo gros rnams nyams mi rnams 'tsho ba don yod min// mtshungs med rgyas pa'i snyan ngag med na mkhas pa nyid ni ne'u tso'i klog dang mtshungs// snying yod rnams kyi nang gi de nyid dpyad pa med na rab mdzes snyan ngag ni// stong pa nyid ni dben pa'i khron pa'i mar me bzhin du nang du bsten par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa yin/

de nyid ston byed kyi gzhung yang mang zhig byung bar snang mod kyang*/ mchog gam bla mar gyur pa ni slob dpon chen po daṇ+ḍi ste dbyig pa can gyis mdzad pa'i snyan ngag me long 'di nyid yin la/ mdzad pa po slob dpon 'di nyid phyi nang gang yin la gleng sgo mi mthun pa mang ste/ phal cher zhig phyi nang thun mong gi paṇ+ḍi ta yin te/ gzhung 'dir/ brtan rgyas dbang po rab bsdams pa// khyod ni sdom ldan phyir mi nyams// zhes sogs dang*/ ma brtags spyod pa 'phags pa ni// rnams la shin tu yod min te// sogs dang*/ ngag yid spyod yul ma yin pa'i// snang ba dam pas khyod la srungs// dang*// bde gshegs 'dus byas 'jig par ni// gsungs pa bden mod de lta na'ang*// zhes sogs nang pa'i grub mtha' ston pa'i tshig mang po dang*/ nyi ma zla ba rlung sa mkha'// sbyin sreg byed dang me dang chu// zhes sogs dang*/ ser skyas gnas la yod pa nyid// rab tu skye bar nye bar brjod// ces sogs phyi rol pa'i grub mtha' ston pa'i tshig yang mang du snang bas so zer/ yang kha cig nang pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta yin te/ bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta dpal 'dzin sdes mdzad pa'i grub brgya'i bris sku bri thabs su/ dbyug pa can ser po bud med dang lhan cig pa zhes pa gzhung 'di mdzad pa po dang*/ rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba dge slong ser po phyag na po ti bsnams pa skyes pa dang lhan cig pa zhes 'byung ba'i sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas mdzad pa po yin zer shes byed 'god/ yang la la/ slob dpon dpa' bo bstan pa 'di la ma zhugs gong gi mtshan la de ltar grags pa'o gsungs pa sogs byung mod kyang*/ bdag cag gi yongs su 'dzin pa mchog gi bzhed pa ni/ gzhung 'di la phyi nang sus kyang thun mong du bslab tu rung ba mang du zin kyang*/ rtsom pa po dngos ni phyi rol ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta yin te/ dmangs do ha las/ dbyu gu dbyug gsum legs ldan gzugs/

'chang zhing dus su mchod pa dang*// zhes gsungs shing*/ mu stegs byed kha cig lha chen gsum gzugs gcig pa nyid du bsams nas de mchod pa'i phyir dbyu gu gcig 'chang bar byed la/ gzhan dag de gsum gzugs tha dad par bsams nas dbyu gu gsum rtse mo dang bar dang rtsa ba rnams su ching mas bcings nas dus dang dang dus su mchod par byed do zhes mu stegs kyi 'dod pa brjod pa'i skabs su gsungs la/ de lta bu'i brtul zhugs la gnas shing gzhol bas na mtshan yang dbyug pa can zhes bya yi/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sgor zhugs pa'i dge bsnyen nam rab tu byung ba gang yin kyang*/ bla dwags kyi ming ngan yin na ma gtogs gzhan de 'dra 'ong ba med la/ 'on kyang 'od srungs chen po dang 'od srungs stobs bcu pa zhes sogs rigs kyi ming nas smos pa dang*/ shā ri'i bu dang rdo rje mo'i bu zhes sogs pha ma'i ming nas smos pa dang*/ yul dang las mtha'i ming nas smos pa sogs ni mang du 'byung la/ dbyug pa dang tho ba la sogs mu stegs dang 'brel ba'i khyim pa sngon rgyal bu gtsug phud can gyi blon po gnyis la btags pa tsam bshad/ lhag par rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa dag la nyan thos sde pa so so'i ming la drangs nas 'dogs par bshad gda'/ de'i phyir/ snyan ngag me long gi 'grel ṭika gi dbu lha la daṇ+ḍi'i sku rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs bris pa dag mthong ba yang ma dag par rgyu mtshan 'dis go bar nus/ 'on kyang slob dpon 'di rang gzhan gyi gzhung dang grub mtha' mang po la mkhas pa zhig yin pa ni dper brjod pa dag gis shes par 'gyur gsungs/ des na gzhung 'di 'chad pa la/ klad kyi don/ gzhung gi don/ mjug gi don gsum las/ dang po la rtsis mgo rnam pa lnga'i sgo nas 'chad par yang mdzad mod/ spyi 'gro la/ mtshan 'gyur ba 'gyur mdzad kyi phyag dang bcas pa 'dums bde bar mdzad de/ dang po ni/

rgya gar skad du/ kā byā dar+shaḥ bod skad du/ snyan ngag me long zhes pa 'di byung*/ de bshad pa la/ rgya gar zhes pa kha cig rgya dkar nag gnyis kyi nang nas rgya dkar po yin pas rgya dkar zhes 'chad pa ni yi ge'i don la ma zhugs so// kha cig rgya nag po las logs shig tu gar bas rgya gar zhes zer ba dang*/ kha cig ri spos rgya dang 'dra ba yod pa'i bod las phyi rol tu gar bas rgya gar te/ rgya gar la bā hir zhes zer ba'i phyir dang*/ kha cig gi phyi'i rgya mtsho las ring du gar bas rgyang gar yin yang*/ bod dang bal po la thal bar mi 'gyur te/ ma he la sa steng nyal zhes zer ba bzhin zer ba de rnams la/ de lta bu'i nges tshig gi bshad pa la 'jug pa'i gzhi/ bod la rgya zhes pa'i skad kyi zur saṃskṛta dang*/ bod skad gnyis ka la med pa'i phyir dang*/ rgya nag la bod skad la yod kyang saṃskṛta la med pa'i phyir dang*/ rgya mtsho la rgya'i zur yod kyang rgya gar gyi ming bā hir la rgya zur med pa'i phyir ro// kha cig rgya dkar nag gnyis kyi nang nas rgya dkar po'i skad gzhir bcas pa la skad rigs bzhi las/ saṃskṛta lha'i skad de bzang shos yin pas rgya gar ma'i skad de/ ja gar ma/ chang gar ma zhes pa'i mtshon pa bzhin no zhes zer ba ni mi 'thad de/ rgya gar gyi prakṛta'i skad rgya gar skad ma yin par thal ba'i phyir dang*/ ston pas skad gzhan gsum gyis gsungs pa'i chos rnams rgya gar skad du gsungs pa min par 'gyur te/ dri med 'od du sde snod gsum ni ma ga dha'i skad kyis so zhes gsungs shing*/ 'dor na rgya gar la skad rigs bzhi yod pa snyam mo// des na rgya gar ni 'phags pa'i yul te aṅga dha dang ma ga dha la sogs pa'i yul phyogs la rgya gar zhes 'dod rgyal du btags pa ste/ 'di'i don gyis rgya 'di'i don gyis gar zhes pa'i nges tshig med de/ smra sgor/ 'dod rgyal thog ma'i ming gang yin// nges tshig gzhi med chos nyid bzhin// zhes so/

rgya gar ni yul yin/ yul ni rgyu 'bras phyogs chas bsdus pa la btags pa yin pas/ de rang skad smra ba ma yin yang*/ yul rgya gar ba'i mi rnams kyi skad la/ rgya gar skad du zhes bar gyi tshig mi mngon par byas pa ste/ ba lang gis drangs pa'i shing rta la/ ba lang gi shing rta zhes pa bzhin no// du ni la dang chos mthun te/ smra sgor/ du la sogs pa la dang mthun// zhes so// la don du ma la 'jug kyang 'dir gzhi'i don te/ rgya gar skad la/ bstan bcos rig pa rnams saṃskṛ ta'i skad/ yul dbus pa rnams pra kṛ ta'i skad/ ri brag pa rnams a wa bh+raṃ sha ta'i skad dang*/ pi shā tsi sha za'i skad la sogs par yod pa las 'dir saṃskṛ ta'i skad la zhes pa'i don yin zhes kun mkhyen bu ston zhabs sogs bzhed pa ltar legs shing*/ de la kā bya snyan ngag a dar+sha me long*/ mtshungs sgras mtshams sbyar bas/ kā byā dar+shaḥ bod skad du zhes pa yang*/ sngon skya seng bu lnga dang*/ dgra ngan dpung tshogs bcu gnyis 'thab pa'i tshe rū pa ti zhes bya ba'i rgyal po dpung gi tshogs shig dang bcas pa g.yul 'gyed pa'i tshe/ bud med kyi cha lugs su byas te bros nas ri kha ba can gyi ri khrod du zhugs nas gnas pa'i rigs las deng sang na yang bod ces bya bar grags pa yin no zhes slob dpon shes rab go chas bshad pa ltar na/ de las mched pa'i mis bzung ba'i yul la bod ces bya ste/ de la bod dang bod chen po gnyis so// bod kyi gtam rgyud ltar na/ spre'u dang brag srin mo las chad pa'i/ pha'i rigs su byung ba rnams kyis bzung ba la bod/ ma'i rigs su byung ba rnams kyis bzung ba la chen po'o// bod yul de'i mi rnams kyi skad la skad rigs mang yang*/ bod yul gyi mthil lo paṇa rnams kyis dam pa'i chos bsgyur zhing gtan la phab pa'i yul de'i mi rnams kyi skad du bsgyur ba na/ snyan ngag me long zhes te/ spyir btags ming la 'dra ba rgyu mtshan du byas pa dang*/

'brel ba rgyu mtshan du byas pa/ ldog pa rgyu mtshan du byas pa rnams su yod cing*/ bye brag bka' bstan bcos kyi mtshan 'dogs lugs la/ mdo dgongs 'grel gyi 'grel pa las/ gsung rab tu gtogs pa thams cad kyi ming ni rnam pa bzhi las 'gyur te/ yul dang*/ dpe dang*/ gang zag dang*/ don las so zhes bzhir gsungs kyang*// rgyu dang 'bras bu dang*/ gzhung tshad kyi ming gis btags pa yang yod ces mkhas pa dag bzhed de/ de yang ga ya go ri'i mdo/ po ṭa la ka'i gzungs/ ko sa la'i rgyan zhes pa lta bu yul dang*/ sā lu ljang pa'i mdo/ rnam 'grel gyi rgyan zhes pa lta bu dpe dang*/ dri ma med par grags pas bstan pa'i mdo dang*/ tsan+d+ra pa'i mdo zhes pa gang zag dang*/ sangs rgyas sa'i mdo/ tshad ma'i mdo zhes pa lta bu don dang*/ gtsug tor dkar mo lta bu rgyu dang*/ rims nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa lta bu 'bras bu dang*/ stong phrag brgya pa'am/ sum cu pa lta bu gzhung tshad dang*/ dge slong gi tshig le'ur byas pa la me tog phreng rgyud ces pa lta bu sdeb sbyor gyi ming gis btags pa yang yod par gsungs la/ jo bo'i lam yig las ni jo bos byang chub lam gyi sgron ma bya ba mdzad nas/ khyed bod na mtshan gyi 'dogs lugs ji lta bu yod ces bka' rmed pa la/ bod ston rnams kyis don la mtshan du gsol ba dang*/ dpe/ yul/ zhu ba po la sogs pa 'dogs zhus pas/ a le bod na rgya gar na med pa'i gtam mang po yod gsungs nas/ rol rnyed ma phrogs pa dang*/ gnod sbyin a sha bsad pa'i gtam rgyud zad kyi gsungs nas/ chos thams cad don la mtshan du gsol ba yin gsungs zhes 'byung mod kyi/ 'dir snyan ngag ni brjod bya'i don// me long ni byed las kyi sgo nas btags pa ste/ snyan ngag tu gang gis 'jog pa ste/ bstan bcos 'di'i nang du gsal bar 'char bas me long zhes te/ 'dra ba rgyu mtshan du byas pa yang yin la brjod bya dang*/

rjod byed 'brel te gzhi mthun gyi bsdu bas/ snyan ngag me long zhes so// dgos pa dang 'brel ba yang yin te/ laṅkar gshegs pa'i mdo las/ ming du gdags par ma mdzad na// 'jig rten thams cad rmongs par 'gyur// de bas rmongs pa bsal ba'i phyir// mgon pos ming du gdags par mdzad// ces gsungs te/ de lta bu'i mtshan de btags pa'i dgos pa ni/ ming klad du smos pas btsal sla/ don de la don ldan gyi ming btags pas/ dbang po rab kyis ming la brten nas don phyin ci ma log par go 'bring gis rnam pa tsam go tha mas kyang brda dus su ming don 'brel ba shes/ tha snyad kyi dus su ming las don rtogs shing*/ don mthong ba las ming dran par 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod la/ ming de skad gnyis zung sbyar du bkod pa'i dgos pa yang*/ bod rnams kyis rgya gar skad de go dka' la/ rang gi skad du bsgyur bas go sla bas sgyur byed lo paṇa la byas shes drin gzo'i blo skye/ skad gnyis kyis don gcig brjod par mthong bas gnyis po rnam grangs su shes/ rgya skad bod skad du bsgyur tshul mthong bas sgra bsgyur ba la blo kha phyogs shing bag chags 'jog la cung zad shes par 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod pa yin// gnyis pa ni/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes te/ phyag 'tshal zhes pa bshad pa'i gzhir drangs te byed pa po gang gis na/ skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang phyug shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis so// yul gang la na/ so so skye bo'i sa las ring du 'phags pas na 'phags pa/ de yang dbyings rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa la/ spang bya glo bur nyon mongs dang rnam rtog gi zug rngu'i rtsub pa dang bral bas na 'jam ste ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs pa'i gnyis su med pa'i ye shes ni dpal/ don gnyis la rgyun chad med pas na gzhon nu ste/ sa dang tshangs spyod kyis phye ba'i gzhon nu gnyis las/

'dir sas phye ba'i gzhon nu/ dag pa gzhon nu'i sa la gnas pa'am/ sku gzhon nu'i cha byad 'dzin pas gzhon nu/ de yang ma skyes pas rtag pa ma yin gyi/ rgyu tshogs gnyis las skyes pas na gyur pa ste/ rnam 'grel las/ ma skyes pa ni bzlog don du// gyur pa nyid gsung de yi phyir// zhes so// yang na/ sher phyin gyi mdo las/ shā ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la la ni sems dang po bskyed phyin chad tshangs par spyod pa yang dag par len te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas kyi bar du gzhon nur gyur pas 'khod do zhes 'byung ba dang*/ 'jam dpal gyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa'i mdo las/ sdig dang 'dod pa spang bya zhing*// tshangs par spyod pa spyad par bya// zhes pa'i don la/ lam sgron gyi 'grel par/ sems bskyed pa nas ji srid byang chub ma thob kyi bar tshangs spyod 'ba' zhig la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la gzhon nur gyur pa zhes bya bar gsungs so// yul de la phyag 'tshal ba'i sgra sbyar ba'i phyir/ la zhes pa'i rnam dbye smos te/ bya ba'i dngos po/ phyag 'tshal ba ste/ mchog tu 'dud pas so// dgos byed ya rabs dang tshul mthun zhing*/ gnas skabs sgra bsgyur ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang*/ mthar thug thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i ched du'o/// / gnyis pa gzhung gi don la gsum/ bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i sgo/ 'jug bya bstan bcos kyi rang bzhin/ de ltar du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu'o// dang po la gnyis te/ shis pa brjod pa dang*/ rtsom par dam bca' ba'o// de la dang po ni/ gdong bzhi gdong gi pad tshal gyi// ngang pa'i bu mo thams cad dkar// dbyangs can ma ni kho bo yi// yid la ring du rol bar mdzod// ces te/ gdong bzhi ni mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa'o// de'i gdong pad+ma'i tshal gyi ngo bor bkod/ de las byung ba'i dbyangs can ma zhes pa'i lhag pa'i lha mo de nyid do// de tshangs pa'i zhal las ji ltar byung na/

sngon tshangs pa'i gdong bzhi las snyan ngag mchod sbyin/ srid srung*/ nges brjod de rig byed bzhi byung bar 'dod cing*/ de las snyan ngag ni swa ra swa tī mtsho ldan nam/ tshig gam/ skad dam/ dbyangs can zhes par 'gyur te/ de ltar yang gzhung 'dir/ snyom las med par rim pas dbyangs can bsten// zhes pa lta bu/ de la mo rtags kyi rkyen byin pas dbyangs can ma ste/ snyan ngag dang dbyangs can ma gcig par byas so// de'i phyir tshangs pa'i bu mo ste/ bram ze phur bus mdzad pa'i bstod pa grub pa ngag gi 'od zer las/ thugs rje mtha' yas pha rol skye bo rjes su gzung ba'i phyir// tshangs pa'i bu mo khyod sku rnam par gsal ba'i rnam 'gyur can// zhes 'byung ngo*/ yang na/ sngon tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas chu klung gi gzugs kyis 'jig rten 'dir babs pa/ 'dzam gling lho phyogs su 'khyil ba tshangs pa'i mtsho zhes bya ba'i chu las rig byed kyi yi ge'i sgra rnams gdangs kyi tshul gyis 'byung ba yod pa la/ phyi rol rig byed pa rnams/ rig byed ni skyes bus ma byas pa'i bden pa don can yin no zhes 'dod cing*/ de lta bu'i mtsho de la swa ra swa tī zhes 'jig rten na grags te/ dkon mchog tā la la'i mdor/ rgya mtsho'i lha mo sgra ldan ma zhes bya// sems can bde 'tsho ji snyed skyes rnams kyi// sgra yi yan lag dbyangs kyi tshul mkhas byed// rang gi gsung gis ngag kun gsal bar byed// chags ldan gti mug can rnams dbyangs can gyi// ngag rnams kyis ni sgra yi tshul mkhas na// gzungs dang chos kyi stobs la dbang thob rnams// lhar bcas 'jig rten ci'i phyir mgu mi byed// ces dang*/ 'chi med mdzod kyi 'grel pa 'dod 'jor/ swa ra swa tī skad dam dbyangs sam dbyangs can nam mtsho ldan te/ mtsho la brten pa nyid kyis yod pa'i phyir ldan pa'i rkyen gyi mtha' can no// 'di sngon tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas tshangs pa'i mtsho la brten nas chu klung gi gzugs kyis 'jig rten 'dir babs so zhes grag go zhes 'byung ba yin la/

ngang pa'i bu mo zhes pa yang 'grel pa de nyid las/ gan+dharba dri za dang gan+dhārba lha'i glu mkhan du 'gyur zhes ra bha sa yi dang po ring ba yang bshad do// sogs kyi sgras sna tshogs dbyig dang*/ ba lang 'tshe dang*/ dga' byed dang*/ sna tshogs shing rta dang*/ snod can dang*/ me sbyin dang*/ ngang pa zhes pa de lta bu la sogs pa rnams so zhes ngang pa dri za'i ming gi rnam grangs su bshad cing*/ dpal mo 'di nyid gzhan du dri za'i bu mor yang grags la/ dri za tam+bu ra'i chung ma'i tshul 'dzin pas lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram na gnas pa la phyi nang gnyis kas 'dod lha byed ces kyang thos te/ bram ze phur bus kyang*/ biṣ+ṇu'i gzugs brnyan tam+bu ra la dga' skyed tshul 'dzin ma// rjes su chags bcas rol pa'i lo ni brgyad gnyis lon pa'i nyams// chu gter 'gram ngos dbu ba'i phreng bas rtse bar dga' ba can// dri za'i rgyal pos mngon bstod nyid kyi rnam thar phul byung rnams// zhes 'byung bas/ ngang pa ste dri za'i bu mo dbyangs can ma dang 'dab chags ngang pa'i bu mo dngos gnyis sgra sbyar/ kun nas sam thams cad dkar ba ni/ lung las/ lha mo dbyangs can dkar ba pad+ma dkar po yi// dbus su bzhugs pa smra mkhas 'dod pa rnams kyis bsgom par bya// zhes pa bzhin nam/ yang na dbyangs can ma mi shes pa'i dri ma dang bral zhing yon tan thams cad kyis dkar ba dang*/ ngang mo kha dog gis dkar ba mgrin pa'i dbyangs snyan dang ldan pa sbyor ba grub/ ci zhig tu rol pa zhe na/ mān se zhes pa yid dang mtsho gnyis ka la 'jug ste/ lha mo yid dang*/ ngang mo mtsho la'o zhes sgra sbyar/ su zhig gi yid la zhe na kho bo yi ste dbyug pa can bdag gi yid la'o// ci lta zhe na/ skad cig tsam ma yin par ring du ste 'dod pa'i dngos po ma grub kyi bar du'o// de yid la rol pas ci bya zhe na/ de'i mthus shes rab phun sum tshogs par 'gyur bas bstan bcos rtsom pa'i spobs pa don du gnyer ba yin kyang dngos su 'dod don de ma brjod pa ni/

ji skad du/ snyan ngag mkhan chen rnams kyis ngag rnams las// slar yang dngos po gzhan nyid rtogs pa yod// gang de grags pa'i cha shas bral bar snang*// zhes dang*/ brjod rim stobs las dngos po ni// zab mo dag kyang gsal ba ste// zhes 'di nyid du 'byung ba ltar ro// yang thun mong ma yin pa 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sras mor nang pa rnams 'dod de/ bram ze phur bus/ spyan ras gzigs dbang zhal gyi mche ba'i rtse las mngon sprul zhing*// zhes gsungs/ tshul ji ltar zhe na/ mdo za ma tog bkod pa las/ bskal pa bzang po 'di'i sngon 'das pa'i dus kyi bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig na/ sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs 'jig rten du byon pa'i tshe 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis/ ma 'ongs pa na snyigs ma lnga dang ldan pa'i sems can rnams sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i cha lugs kyis mi 'dul bar/ phyi rol pa'i lha'i gzugs dang rtags dang mtshan mas 'dul bar gzigs nas/ lha thams cad mkhyen pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so// de nas dbang phyug dpral ba nas phyung*/ tshangs pa phrag pa g.yas nas/ khyab 'jug phrag pa g.yon nas/ nyi ma spyan g.yas nas/ zla ba g.yon nas/ chu lha lto ba nas/ dbyangs can ma zhal gyi mche ba'i rtse las phyung ngo zhes 'byung ba'i phyir ro// des na 'di la zhal bzhi med pas gdong bzhi gdong gi zhes ji ltar 'brel snyam na/ rgya dper/ tsa turmukha zhes 'byung ba zhal bzhi'am gdong bzhi'am/ kha bzhi/ sgo bzhi zhes pa ci rigs su 'gyur ba las/ 'dir slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug gis/ sgo bzhi can zhal pad+ma yi// tshal gyi ngang pa'i bu mo'i gsung*// thams cad dkar ba zhes bsgyur te// 'di la tshad med pa bzhi'i sgo dang ldan pas gtan tshigs dang 'brel la/ de las btang snyoms tshad med pa'i cha ni shes rab ste don gyi lha mo 'di nyid yin cing*/ rgyud sde rin po che rnams las/

'jam dpal gyi yum du'ang gsungs la/ ngo bo sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma yin kyang*/ phyi nang gnyis kas yi dam gyi lhar 'dzin pas/ thugs rje ris med du 'jug cing*/ byin rlabs shin tu che bas khyad par du 'phags la/ tshig don lhag ma sngar bzhin no// des na 'di'i rgyan ni sbyar ba'i gzugs can yin te/ grogs mo khyod kyi gdong pad ni// rā dza haṃ sas spyad byar 'os// dri zhim bung bas don gnyer 'os// zhes pa sbyar ba'i gzugs can no// zhes pa'i mtshan nyid tshang ba'i phyir ro// 'on kyang 'dod don dngos su ma brjod pas rnam grangs brjod pa'am cha'i rgyan kyang cung zhig 'dres par mngon la/ 'di ni shis brjod bstan bcos rtsom pa'i sgor byas pa ste/ lhag pa'i lha la bstod pas bsod nams 'phel la/ bsod nams ldan pa'i mi yis bsam pa rnams kyang 'grub// ces mdo las gsungs shing*/ yid la rol bar smon pas rang gi yi dam yin par yang bstan te/ 'di las gzhan pa'i bshad tshul mang yang rtsom pa po'i dgongs bzhed med du mi rung ba ni de tsam mo gsungs/ de ltar mchod par brjod dgos pa yang*/ ji skad du/ bstan bcos byed pa'i dam pa yi// ston pa la ni mchod brjod bya// bstan pa spel phyir dag pa'i tshig /'di la 'thad pa bzang po mthong*// zhes 'byung ba yin// gnyis pa rtsom par dam bca' ba ni/ bstan bcos snga ma rnams bsdus shing*// sbyor ba rnams kyang nyer mtshon te// ji ltar nus bzhin bdag gis ni// snyan ngag rnams kyi mtshan nyid bya// zhes te/ sngon skye dgu'i tshe lo nyi khri pa'i dus// drang srong rgyas pas brtsams pa'i bstan bcos bha ra ta tshogs bdag gis yig mkhan byas nas bris par grags pa'i gzhung sh+lo ka 'bum lhag bcas yod pa dang*/ me bzhin 'jug gi bu mo zhes bya bas byas pa'i snyan ngag sgom pa'i chos dang*/ drang srong grog mkhar gyis byas pa'i rā ma ya na zhes pa rgyal po rā ma ṇa dang btsun mo rol rnyed ma'i lo rgyus snyan ngag tu sbyar ba sh+lo ka 'bum yod pa dang*/

markeṇa ḍe yas byas pa'i bstan bcos aṣ+ṭa dā sha su rā ste sngon gyi rabs bco brgyad dam sngon rabs kyi chos zhes pa khyab 'jug gi 'jug pa sogs ston pa sh+lo ka 'bum lhag bcas yod pa zhig dang*/ kā li dā sa ste nag mo'i khol po'am nag mo'i 'bangs kyis sbyar ba'i snyan ngag gzhon nu 'byung ba dang*/ rā ma sharmas mdzad pa'i snyan ngag gi bstan bcos ra ghu waṃ sha zhes pa sh+lo ka stong phrag brgyad cu yod pa sogs bstan bcos snga ma rnams las bsdus te bya'o// de ltar btags zin 'thag pa dang*/ grub zin sgrub pa'i rigs pas ci zhig bya zhe na/ de dag na gzhung tshogs che zhing tshig don gab 'khrugs 'thor khams can du gnas pas rtogs dka' la/ 'dir rā ma sharma'i gzhung las gtso bor bstan cing*/ bha ra ta'i bstan bcos las/ sbyar ba rab dang mnyam nyid ting nge 'dzin// snyan nyid gzi brjid tshig ni shin tu gzhon// don yang gsal dang rgya che mdzes pa ste// 'di dag snyan ngag rnams kyi yon tan bcu// zhes pa'i sbyor ba legs pa rnams kyang nye bar mtshon nas tshig dang don gyi legs cha mtha' dag bsdus/ yi ge'i tshogs phri/ lhag chad nor 'khrul gyis ma reg par nyung ngu rnam gsal gyi tshul du'o// yang na/ tshig gi sbyor ba'i dper brjod pa rnams kyang nye bar mtshon nas zhes pa'i don du gzung ngo*// ji ltar nus bzhin zhes khengs bskyungs pa'i tshig gis bstan bcos rtsom pa po mngon pa'i nga rgyal med pas dam par mtshon nus pa dang*/ de ltar mi nus bzhin du 'bad pa ni don chen po dang ldan pa zhig go snyam bstan bcos khyad par can du ston pa ste/ de'i phyir mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo las/ nus pa med kyang 'bad bzhin du// bstan bcos la yang 'jug pa'i tshig /bstan bcos dang ni ston byed pa// gnyis ka dam par bstan phyir yin// zhes so// su yis na dbyug pa can bdag gis te/ lus dang rgyan gyis bsdus pa'i snyan ngag rnams kyi mtshan nyid gsal bar bya'o// zhes dam bcas pa ste/

klu sgrub zhabs kyis/ lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu las/ dam pa khas 'che mang po mi byed cing*// gal te dka' ba'i khas ni blangs gyur na// rdo la ri mo bris pa ji bzhin du// shi yang gzhan du 'dor bar mi 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pa bzhin rtsom pa mthar phyin pa'i don dang*/ yang mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo las/ dam bca' ba dang bskul tshig sogs// 'chad phyir spro ba ston pa ste// mchog rtogs 'grub pa'i rgyur 'gyur bas// khas len pa la 'gal ba med// ces gsungs pa'i don/ dam bca' ba la dgos don/ bsdus don/ tshig don gsum las/ dang po bshad par bya'o zhes pas/ gzhung 'chad pa la spro ba dang*/ rang nyid mkhas par ston pa dang*/ dam bca' 'grub pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba dang*/ nyan par bskul ba'i dgos pa sogs yod/ bsdus pa'i don la las dang byed po bya ba gsum ste/ gang bshad na bstan bcos/ gang gis na byed pa po'am rtsom pa pos/ ji ltar bshad na rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gang rung gi sgo nas 'chad pa lta bu/ tshig don ni gang 'chad rgyu'i tshig la 'jug pa rnams yin/// / rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa 'jug bya bstan bcos kyi rang bzhin la yang gsum ste/ dgos don/ bsdus don/ mtshams sbyar brgal lan dang bcas pas tshig don bshad pa dang gsum du byas na legs te/ rnam bshad rigs pa las/ mdo don smra ba rnams kyis ni// dgos pa bsdus pa'i don dang bcas// tshig don bcas shing mtshams sbyar bcas// brgal lan bcas te bsnyad par bya// zhes pa'i 'chad thabs kyi man ngag dang mthun pa'i phyir ro// gzhung de nyid las/ mdo don che ba nyid thos nas// nyan dang len pa la sogs pa// nyan pa de la gus 'gyur bas// thog mar dgos pa brjod par bya// zhes dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta zla ba mngon dgas/ bstan bcos dag ni thams cad dang*// las ni ci yang rung ba yi// ji srid dgos pa ma smras pa// de srid du ni ci zhig 'dzin// zhes dang*/

mkhas 'jug las/ bstan bcos dam pa bstan pa'i phyir// ston pas thog mar dgos pa bstan// yongs su rtogs pa de mthong na// dpyod pa la yang cis mi 'jug /ces gsungs pa bzhin thog mar dgos don 'chad pa yin te/ de la sde bzhi'i tha snyad 'jug pa/ grags pa dus ring por gnas pa/ yon tan dang skyon 'byed pa/ des na bstan bcos brtsams pa de bzhir byed pa dang*/ bstan bcos rtsom pa'i yon tan/ ma brtsams pa'i skyon/ legs par brtsams pa de yun ring du gnas pa'i rgyu mtshan/ rtsom byed mkhas rmongs kyi khyad par/ rtsom pa'i skyon spong thabs/ bstan bcos mi shes pa'i skyon mkhas pas legs par dbye ba dang bdun du 'byed pa sogs 'chad lugs sna tshogs shig yod kyang*/ re zhig phyi ma ltar bshad na spyi 'gro dang mthun pas de bzhin du byas na/ dang po rtsom pa'i yon tan ni/ 'di na kun tu lhag ma dang*// mchog gi rjes su bstan pa yi// tshig rnams nyid kyi drin gyis ni// 'jig rten lugs la 'jug par byed// 'jig rten 'di na rnam pa kun tu skyon yon 'byed pa ni/ bstan bcos kho na la rag las te legs sbyar gyi skad kyi lhag ma rang bzhin gyi skad sogs dang*/ mchog brda sprod kyi bstan bcos byed po rnams kyis byings rkyen legs par sbyar bas rjes su bstan pa'i snyan tshig gi rig pa rnams kyi drin las/ 'jig rten gyi lugs sde chen po bzhi'i skyon yon ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs nas/ de dang de'i blang dor gyi gnas ma 'khrul ba'i lugs srol rnam par dag pa la 'jug par byed ces pa'i don dang*/ 'gyur khyad shong ston chen pos/ 'di na kun tu mchog rnams kyang*// zhes pa ltar na/ 'di na rnam pa kun tu snyan ngag la mkhas 'dod kyi skyes bu mchog gam chen po rnams kyang*/ gya tshoms su ma yin te sngon gyi slob dpon mkhas mchog rnams kyis rjes su bstan pa/ bstan bcos khyad par can gyi tshig gi drin gyis blang dor phye nas/

'jig rten lugs kyi 'dod don phun sum tshogs pa la 'jug par byed ces bya ba'i don yin// gnyis pa ma brtsams pa'i skyon ni/ de nyid slar yang ldog phyogs kyi sgo nas ston par bzhed nas/ gal te sgrar bod snang ba yis// 'khor ba'i bar du mi gsal na// 'jig rten gsum po mtha' dag 'di// smag rum mun pa nyid du 'gyur// zhes gsungs te/ gal te zhes pa brtags pa mthar bzung ba'i tshig de yang*/ brjod bya'i don dang rjod byed kyi phyin ci ma log par ston pa'i sgrar bod pa ste bsnyad pa'i bstan bcos khyad par can gyi snang bas/ 'khor ba ji srid gnas kyi bar du mi gsal ba ste gsal bar ma byas pa de'i tshe na/ lha klu mi'i 'jig rten gsum po 'di phyogs tsam min par mtha' dag kha khra'i klo bzhin du legs nyes mi phyed pa/ smag rum 'thibs por rgyas pa'i mi shes pa'i mun pa 'thug pos khebs pa nyid du 'gyur zhes pa'i tha tshig ste/ legs par bshad pa'i snang ba gsal pa las gsar pa 'gyed pa ni mchog tu gces so zhes pa'i don yin/ 'gyur gzhan du/ gal te sgra don snang ba yis// zhes 'byung ba'ang*/ sgra don phyin ci ma log pa'i bstan bcos khyad par can gyi snang bas zhes 'grel dgos te mi mthun pa cher med do// gsum pa legs par brtsams pa de yun du gnas pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ dgos pa gzhan yang yod de/ sngon gyi rgyal po grags pa'i gzugs// ngag gi rang bzhin me long thob// de dag nye bar mi gnas kyang*// rang nyid nyams pa med la ltos// zhes pa ste/ ji ltar sngon gyi rgyal po nga las nu dang*/ zla ba'i 'od dang*/ dpal gyi sde dang*/ thams cad sgrol dang*/ gtsug na nor bu la sogs pa chos kyi rgyal thabs chen po de dag gi /rigs dang bsod nams/ stobs dang 'byor pa/ snying stobs dang brtson 'grus dpa' ba dang rtul phod pa/ thos pa dang gtong ba la sogs pa'i grags pa dkar po'i gzugs brnyan gtam du grags pa'i ngag gi rang bzhin me long du gsal zhing rdzogs pa nges par thob la/

bstod yul gyi rgyal po de dag 'das nas yun ring lon pas da lta nye bar mi gnas kyang*/ rang rang so so nyid yod pa ltar snyan grags kyi gzugs brnyan da dung nyams pa med pa 'di lta bu la ltos shig ces sgrub byed dngos su bkod nas/ shugs las bstan bya'i bsgrub bya/ snyan ngag gi lus rgyan phun sum tshogs pa'i bstan bcos brtsam na/ de nyid dang rtsom pa po'i grags pa srid mthar yang mi nyams pa dpag bsam 'khri shing lta bu'o zhes ston pa ste/ ma brjod na yang 'dod pa ni/ shugs las rtogs par 'gyur ba yin// gsung ba ltar ro// bzhi pa rtsom byed mkhas rmongs kyi khyad par ston pa'am/ bstan bcos kyi khyad par gyi skyon yon bskyed pa ji lta bu zhe na/ mkhas pas yang dag rab sbyar ba'i// ngag ni ngag gi 'dod 'jor bshad// de nyid nyes par sbyar na slar// sbyor po ba lang nyid rjod byed// ces te/ gzhung lam 'dir sbyangs pa'i mkhas pa yid ches kyi gnas rnams kyis yang dag par rab tu sbyar ba'i ngag ni tshig rgyan gyi sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pas nyams dang 'gyur ba'i khyad par dang ldan pa'i tshig don bzang po zad med 'byung bas ngag gi 'dod pa bzhin yid bzhin du 'jo bar byed la/ ngag de nyid legs par ma yin pa'i tshig nyes pa zhig sbyar na/ blun pos byas pa tshig sbyor dang bral ba'i phyir/ bstan bcos de nyid gzhan gyis 'dor bar ma zad/ slar tshig don sbyor ba po yang blun rmongs mi'i sha tshugs can gyi ba lang lta bur go bar byed ces pa'i don te/ 'di'i rgya dper/ gaurgaḥkā ma du ghā swa mya kapra yuk+tā sma r+ya te bu bh+yaiḥzhes yod pa'i gau sgra lan gnyis su zlos pa 'di la/ shong ston chen pos ngag tshig rnam grangs su mdzad de/ mkhas pas yang dag rab sbyar ba'i// ngag tshig 'dod pa 'jo bar dran// zhes bsgyur ba dang*/ klu sgrub kyis zhib mo rnam 'thag las/ ngag phyogs sa dang 'od zer dang*// phyugs dang mig dang rdo rje dang*// mtho ris chu ste don dgu la// mkhas pas gau sgra nges par bzung*// zhes dang*/

sgra sbyor bam po gnyis par/ gau ta ma lta bu gau'i sgra las tshig dang phyogs dang sa dang 'od dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ ba lang dang mtho ris la sogs pa rnams du mar snyegs pa dang zhes 'byung bas/ phyis kyi mkhas pa 'gas/ ngag dang tshig gnyis don gcig ming gi rnam grangs yin pas zlos par song la/ des na/ ngag ni mtho ris 'dod pa 'jo// zhes bsgyur na shin tu legs te 'ga' zhig legs par sbyor ba'i skad gcig pus mtho ris su 'dod pa 'jo zhes pa dang bstun pa'o zhes 'gyur bcos// yang*/ de la kha cig gis/ rig byed pa rnams lha kho na la mtho ris zer bas/ mi'i snyan ngag gis lha'i 'dod pa 'jo bar mi 'gyur/ sa la zhes bsgyur na 'byor te/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du// yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten lags par gsungs// zhes pa ltar/ sa yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas yin pa ngag gi dper bkod pa dang*/ snyan ngag mkhas pas sa steng du ngo mtshar bskyed/ grags pa thob pas/ ngag ni sa la 'dod pa 'jo// zhes pa paṇ+ḍi ta pur+ṇaṇā nan+da las thos so// gsungs pa sogs rnam grangs te/ 'di ni dpang lo chen pos 'gyur bcos gnang ba'i don ltar la 'chad lugs 'di bzhin mdzad do// lnga pa rtsom pa'i skyon spong thabs ni/ de'i phyir skyon chung yang spong dgos so zhes 'doms par bzhed nas/ de phyir snyan ngag dag la skyon// chung bar gyur kyang ci zhig ltar// btang snyoms mi bya lus mdzes kyang*// skyon gcig gis ni skal ngan 'gyur// gong du smos pa'i rgyu mtshan de dag gi phyir snyan ngag shes pa dag gis tshig sbyor 'god pa'i gnas skabs su brjod bya/ brjod tshig rgyan/ rnam dbye/ sbyor tshul/ tshig gi phrad sogs gang dang ci'i gnas skabs su skyon gyi cha shas chung ngu tsam zhig chags par gyur kyang*/ 'di tsam gyis skyon chen po bskyed par mi nus so snyam btang snyoms su 'jog par mi rigs te/

blo gros zhib mos legs par brtags nas skyon gdags su med par bya dgos/ de ltar ma byung tshe ci zhig ltar zhe na/ dper na/ skyes bu zhig lus kyi rnam pa gzhan shin tu mdzes par yod du zin kyang sna nag po sogs skyon phra mo zhig gis gzugs byad skal ngan du byed de/ bkra mi shis pa'i grangs su bgrang bar 'gyur ba dang 'dra bas brtags shing gzhigs nas dpyad par bzod pa dag brtsam par bya dgos zhes pa'i tha tshig go /drug pa bstan bcos mi shes pa'i skyon ni/ de lta bu'i legs nyes 'byed shes pa yang*/ skye bo'i bstan bcos kho na la rag las kyis/ rang stobs kyis ma yin no zhes ston pa ste/ skye bo bstan bcos mi shes pas// yon tan skyon dag ji ltar dbye// gzugs kyi dbye ba dmigs pa'i skabs// long ba dag la yod dam ci// zhes skye bo gang zhig bstan bcos spyi dang bye brag snyan ngag gi bstan bcos la ma sbyangs shing mi shes pa dag gis/ bstan bcos kyi tshig don gyi char/ 'di ni skyon yin no// 'di ni yon tan yin no zhes ji ltar dbye bar nus te mi nus la/ de nyid zla bo dngos po'i dpes bsgrub pa la/ gzugs kyi dbyibs kyi kha dog mtshar mi mtshar gyi rnam par dbye ba mig long ba dag la smra rgyu yod dam ci zhes pa ste med pa kho na yin no// bdun pa mkhas pas legs par dbye ba'i dbang du mdzad nas/ de phyir mkhas pas skye dgu rnams// bye brag rtogs la mngon dgongs nas// rnam bkra lam ldan tshig rnams kyi// bya ba'i cho ga nges par sbyar// zhes bya ba smos te/ snyan ngag legs nyes kyi rnam dbye shes pa ni gang la brten rgyu'i bstan bcos rnam par dag pa la rag las pa de'i phyir/ sngon gyi slob dpon mkhas pa rnams kyis skye dgu ste skye bo cog rnams kyi rgyud la/ legs nyes la sogs pa bye brag rtogs par bya ba la mngon par dgongs pas bltas nas/

lus mdzes sgra don gyi rgyan gyis rnam par bkra ba'i lam dang ldan pa'i snyan tshig gi rig pa shes par bya ba'i cho ga zhes sam/ rtsom pa'i thabs khyad par can sbyar nas/ nges par zhes pa gdon mi za bar gtan la 'bebs par mdzad do zhes pa'i don yin/ de ltar tshig tu brjod pa dag gis grub bo// brjod par bya ba gzhung 'di nyid las rtogs par bya ba'i snyan ngag gi mtshan nyid dang*/ rjod par byed pa 'di nyid kyi gzhung gi tshogs brjod don lus dang rgyan gyi rnam bzhag de gzhung 'di nyid las rtogs par 'gyur ba de dgos pa/ de las rnyed grags rgya cher 'byung zhing mkhas pa'i khri la dbang ba ni dgos pa'i dgos pa'am nying dgos/ de dgos pa la rag las shing*/ dgos pa bstan bcos la ltos pa'am/ gong du smos pa'i brjod bya rjod byed kyi mtshan nyid ni 'brel ba yin la/ yang na/ snyan ngag gi lus rgyan skyon sel ba dang bcas pa bstan bcos 'di'i brjod bya 'di la brten nas de rnams bde blag tu rtogs par dgos la/ de la brten nas sde bzhi'i blang dor gyi gnas phyin ci ma log par shes pa nying dgos/ dgos sogs gsum dang bstan bcos 'di thabs thabs byung du gnas pa ni 'brel ba'o// thun mong ma yin pa rang re nang pa'i mthar thug gi dgos pa ni/ mdo las/ dam pa'i chos gsal bar bya ba'i snyan ngag bya'o// dkon mchog gsum la bstod pa bya'o// de las bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur ro zhes dang*/ bskal pa bzang po'i mdo las gsungs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa dus mkhyen rgyal po ni// snyan ngag mkhan de bde gshegs rtswa mchog la// tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis bstod nas kyang*// dang por byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do// zhes dang*/ 'o skol gyi ston pas kyang sangs rgyas skar rgyal la snyan ngag gi tshigs su bcad pa gcig gis bstod pas bskal pa bzhi khri'i tshogs bzlums par gsungs pa lta bus mtshon te/

zhing dang bsam pa'i khyad par gyi grogs dang ldan pas bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa mthar thug gi dgos pa khyad par ba yin la gong gi nying dgos ni gnas skabs tsam mo// 'o na slob springs las/ bud med yan lag dri nga rul ba mi sdug pa// pad+ma zla ba ut+pal dag tu snyoms byed pa/ snyan ngag mkhan gyi rdzun de'i 'bras bu mi bzad pa// de dag de yi mngal nas 'jug pa de bzhin no// zhes dang*/ mdo dran nyer/ snyan ngag gtso bor byed pa rnams lha yul gyi bya/ gzhan dag tshig bcad kyis bskul zhing rang bag med du sdod par skye bar bshad pa sogs ci zhe na/ de dag gis 'dod pa'i gtam gyi snyan ngag mi bya bar dgongs pa ste/ 'dir yang*/ don dang bral ba'i khyad par rnams// ma byas gnas su bsngags pa dang*// zhes gsungs pa yin// 'o na/ 'di'i dper brjod rnams las 'dod pa'i gtam mang du 'byung ba ma yin nam zhe na/ bden mod kyi/ de ni rjes 'jug rnams 'jug bde zhing go sla ba'i don du mdzad pa yin te/ ji skad du/ thabs la mkhas pa'i spyod pa la// g.yo sgyur thub pas gsungs pa med// ces pa bzhin te/ 'phros pas chog go /de ltar dgos sogs kyi chos bzhi 'god pa'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ rnam dpyod dang ldan pa dag bstan bcos 'di la brjod bya med dam snyam pa dang*/ brjod bya yod kyang*/ rjod byed de la dgos pa med dam snyam pa dang*/ dgos pa yod srid kyang dgos pa'i dgos pa med dam snyam pa dang*/ de yod kyang sgrub pa'i thabs med dam snyam pa'i log rtog rnams bsal nas don 'gyur gyi the tshom bskyed pa'i ched yin no// gnyis pa bsdus pa'i don ni/ de rnams kyis ni snyan ngag gi lus dang rgyan yang rab tu bstan// zhes te/ gong du smos pa bzhin/ sngon gyi slob dpon de rnams kyis snyan ngag gi lus tshogs pa'i ngo bo dang*/ de mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan gnyis su rab tu bstan zhing gsal bar byas so zhes mdor bstan pa yin te/

mkhas 'jug las/ bshad sla ba dang bzung bde zhing*// bstan bcos la yang rtsod bral phyir// mkhas pa la la bstan bcos lus// bsdus te thog mar 'god par mdzad// ces pa bzhin/ 'chad pa po bshad sla/ nyan pa po rnams bzung bde/ dkyus sa mthong ba'i rta dkyus rtse ba la bag mi tsha ba lta bu yin gsungs par 'dug/ ༈ gsum pa mtshams sbyor brgal lan dang bcas pas tshig gi don bshad pa la/ lus bshad pa/ rgyan bshad pa/ zhar la skyon sel ba bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po lus bshad pa la/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshan gzhi'o// dang po ni/ lus ni re zhig 'dod pa yi// don gyi rnam dpyad tshig gi phreng*// zhes te/ snyan ngag gi lus kyi mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ de la re zhig smra ba po'i brjod 'dod kyis kun nas bslangs pa'i brjod bya gang zhig tshig rgyan gyi bstan bcos las bshad pa'i nges pa las ma 'das par/ don dang don ma yin pa gang dag rnam par dpyad nas/ rjod byed tshig gi phreng ba legs par spel ba zhig yin// gnyis pa mtshan gzhi rnam par dbye ba la gsum ste/ lus gzhung gi dbye bas gsum du bshad/ rjod byed skad rigs kyi dbye bas bzhir bshad/ brjod tshul don gyi dbye bas gnyis su bstan pa'o// dang po la mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad gnyis kyi dang po ni/ de yang tshigs bcad lhug pa dang*// spel ma rnam gsum nyid du gnas// bshad ma thag pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi lus de yang tshigs bcad de rkang par bcad pa dang*/ lhug pa de rkyang pa dang*/ de gnyis spel ma ste/ rnam pa gsum nyid du gnas zhes pa'i don/ 'di'i skabs su/ sa paṇ+ḍi tas sdeb sbyor sna tshogs me tog chun por/ tshigs su bcad dang lhug pa dang*// rgyun chags zhes bya rnam pa gsum// tshig gi sbyor ba byed 'dod pa'i// mkhas pa rnams kyi 'jug ngogs yin// zhes rgyun chags lus gsum par mdzad cing*/ de yang bcad dang ma bcad pa'o zhes rkang pas ma bcad pa'i rgyun chags bzhed pa'i rgyab skyor du/

sdeb sbyor gyi tshoms las/ rkang pa dag gis ma bcad cing*// gang la yi ge sbrel legs yod// bya ba'i tshig gis gsal byas pa// de ni rgyun chags las gzhan min// zhes drangs pa la/ dpang lo chen pos/ de ni mkhas pa'i gsung yin yang bstan bcos chen po rnams dang 'gal bas yid ches pa'i gnas su gzung bar mi bya'o zhes dang*/ gzhung de skad ces bya ba yang tha snyad kyi gtsug lag dang*/ de smra ba gzhan rnams la grags pa ma mthong la/ de lta bu rgyun chags yin na bya ba'i tshig yod pa'i lhug pa rnams rgyun chags su thal bar 'gyur zhing*/ de 'dra'i rnam gzhag gzhung 'di dang sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas la sogs par ma smos pa dang*/ rkang pa med pa'i tshig gi rgyun ni lhug pa kho nar bshad pas so gsung ba byung bar brten/ mkhas pa mang pos phyogs 'then gyi ku co mang du mdzad mod kyang byi la'i mjug ma'i shog tshal bzhin du 'khor ba 'ba' zhig tu snang la/ mi dgos ka med kyi dgag sgrub tu'ang mi 'dug pa dang*/ yul dam pa la smad pa'i nyes par gyur dogs bzhag mod/ dpyad par 'dod na 'dir bkod pa'i bzhed pa gnyis la brtags pas tshegs med du gsal ba lags// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la/ tshigs bcad/ lhug pa/ spel ma gsum las/ dang po tshigs su bcad pa la bzhi ste/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ des brtsams pa'i snyan ngag chen po'i mtshan nyid/ sbyor tshul 'ga' zhig mtshon pa'o// dang po ni/ tshigs bcad rkang bzhi can zhes pas bstan te/ gzhung lugs gzhan 'ga' dang*/ khyad par mngon pa kun las btus las/ tshigs bcad rkang pa gcig pa nas bzung ste rkang pa drug pa'i bar du yod par bshad mod kyi/ snyan ngag pa de rang lugs la tshigs su bcad pa rkang pa bzhi pa kho nar nges zhes pa'o// gnyis pa dbye ba la gnyis/ sdeb sbyor gyi sgo nas gnyis su dbye/ sbyor tshul gyi sgo nas bzhir dbye ba'o// dang po ni/ de yang*/ bṛt+tadzā ti zhes rnam gnyis// de yi spros pa mtha' dag ni// sdeb sbyor gzhung du nges par bstan// rig de snyan ngag rgya mtsho ni// zab mo brgal 'dod rnams kyi gru// zhes sdeb sbyor dang snyan ngag gi lugs la tshigs bcad rkang bzhir nges pa de la yang*/

gang du dbyangs kyi yi ge bgrang ba ni bṛt+ta ste/ zhugs pa'am/ sbyar ba'am/ 'phel ba zhes pa'i don/ phyi mo bgrang ba ni dzā ti ste/ rigs sam/ bskyed pa zhes bya ste rnam pa gnyis/ de gnyis las ji snyed pa'i dbye bar gyes pa sogs spros pa'i bya ba mtha' dag ni/ slob dpon rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba dang*/ drang srong dmar ser dang*/ rgyal ba'i lha sogs kyis mdzad pa'i sdeb sbyor gyi gzhung gzhan du bstan pas der shes par bya zhing*/ rig pa de ni snyan ngag gi rgya mtsho zab cing rgya che ba rgal bar 'dod pa dag gi gru dang gzings lta bu yin zhes pa'o// gnyis pa sbyor tshul lam/ rigs kyi sgo nas bzhir dbye ba ni/ grol ba dang ni rigs dang mdzod// 'dus pa zhes bya de 'dra la// tshigs bcad rgya che sargas bcings// cha shas rang bzhin phyir ma brjod// ces pa'i don sa paṇ+ḍi tas/ tshigs bcad gcig gis brjod bya'i don// rdzogs pa grol ba yin par 'dod// ces dang*/ dpang los/ grol ba ni tshigs bcad gcig gis don rdzogs pa rang dbang can tshigs bcad gzhan la mi ltos pa ste zhes gsungs te/ tshigs su bcad pa gcig gi nang du don gcig rang dbang can du rdzogs par ston pa ni grol ba zhes bya ste/ rgyal ba'i skyes rabs las/ gzhan don spyod pa gang gis yon tan bsgrubs pa phun tshogs rnams// rang don la cher 'bad rnams kyis kyang rjes 'gro min pa nyid// thams cad mkhyen zhes phyin ci ma log yi ge'i dregs pa bsal// mnyam med de ni chos dang dge 'dun bcas la gtsug gis 'dud// ces gsungs pa lta bu yang*/ tshigs bcad phan tshun 'dus pa las// brjod bya rtogs pa rigs 'gre yin// zhes dang*/ rigs ni bya ba'i tshig gcig gi sgo nas tshigs bcad phan tshun ltos te brjod bya rdzogs shing so so re re la don ma rdzogs pa tshigs bcad mang pos don gcig kho na rdzogs/ byed pa ste zhes 'byung bas/

brjod bya'i don gcig la sh+lo ka du ma tshogs pa la bya ba'i tshig rigs gcig gis rdzogs pa ni rigs zhes bya ste/ dpag bsam 'khri shing gi gtsug na nor bu'i rtogs brjod yal 'dab las/ mdzes ma des kyang mi bdag ni// brtan ldan zab cing mdzes pa dag /gzhan gyi gdung la snying rje nas// gzhu bzhag 'dod pa'i dbang phyug bzhin// gtsug gi rin chen 'od zer ni// mi rung 'jigs par byed pa yi// phyogs su bsrung ba'i yig phreng dag /gur gum gyis ni bris pa bzhin// rlung ni g.yob cing 'phen byed pa'i// rnga yab dag gis rnam mdzes pa// 'gro ba yang dag sgrol min par// snying stobs gyen du 'phyur bcas bzhin// rig chen yid 'ong do shal dag /snying gar bzung bar byas pa ni// sa 'og rgud pa zhi ba'i slad// lhag ma can gyis brtan pa bzhin// che ba'i dpung pas sa dang ni// sems kyis bzod pa thob pa dag /mthong nas mngon par 'dod pa dang*// ya mtshan dbang du rab tu gyur// brjod bya rgyal po mthong ba// rjod byed sh+lo ka lnga dang*/ rab tu gyur zhes bya tshig gcig gis gsal bar byas pa lta bu dang*/ yang snyan ngag chen po dam pa tog dkar po'i spyod pa zhes bya ba'i sarga dang por/ gnas gtsang ma yi rigs byung rnams// zhes nas/ mig dag yang yang bskyod 'gyur ba'o// zhes pa'i bar sh+lo ka bco brgyad/ 'ongs par 'gyur zhes bya tshig gcig gis gsal ba dang*/ slob dpon rat+na shrī'i 'grel par/ de'i bye brag ni zung can no zhes sh+lo ka gnyis kyis don gcig ston pa'ang 'di'i khongs su bsdus so// yang*/ gnas skabs gcig la yul tha dad// bya ba tha dad ston pa mdzod// ces dang*/ mdzod ni bcad mtshams sna tshogs pa dang bya ba'i tshig sna tshogs pa rang dbang can mdzod ltar gnas pa rnams te zhes gsungs te/ gcod mtshams dang bya tshig sna tshogs shing sh+lo ka'i grangs nges bzung med par brjod bya'i nor du mas gtams pa ni mdzod yin te/

yal 'dab dang po rab gsal gyi rtogs brjod las/ nam zhig sa yi dbang phyug de// mngun sar bzhugs la glang po yi// nags kyi bdag po mngon phyogs te// pus mo sa la btsugs nas smras// lha gcig khyod grags thos gyur nas// sa srung sa la 'ong ba lta'i// glang chen mchog tu mdzes pa ni// rmad du byung ba bdag gis bzung*// skabs gsum bar 'os so gnyis 'di// sgo na gnas so rab tu gzigs// gang phyir jo bos gzigs gyur na// g.yog 'khor yongs ngal 'bras dang bcas// de dag thos nas mi bdag ni// blon la yang dag bgros nas song*// zhes pa lta bu'o// yang*/ yul gcig bya ba du ma yis// bsngags pa tshogs pa yin par bshad// ces dang*/ 'dus pa ni gcod mtshams srod la sogs pa'i bsngags pa lta bu gcig la/ sh+lo ka mang po rnams tshogs nas 'jug pa bya ba'i tshig tha dad pa rnams te zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ brjod bya'i don gcig la sh+lo ka mang po bya tshig kyang mang po 'dus nas ston pas 'dus pa ste/ yal 'dab dang por/ gzi brjid la brten lha rnams kyis// gang gi grags pa mngon mchod pa// rab gsal zhes bya'i sa bdag de// der ni sa yi thig ler gyur// gang gi grags pa'i me tog gi /dog pa yon tan dri bzang tshogs// phyogs kun ri dwags mig can ma'i// rna ba yi ni rgyan du gyur// thabs shes ldan pa gang gi bka'// sa skyong mgo yi tshogs rnams la// gser gyi me tog dri med kyi// phreng ba bzhin du rab tu bgyid// ces brjod bya rgyal po gcig nyid// rjod byed sh+lo ka gsum dang*/ gyur/ bgyid/ ces bya tshig mang pos gsal ba lta bu ste/ de 'dra mang du tshogs pa'i tshigs bcad rgya che ba ni/ sarga zhes pa le'u'am/ rab byed dam/ skabs du mas bcings pa ni snyan ngag chen po/ grol ba sogs gzhi de'i rgyu snal ma lta bu/ snyan ngag chen po snam bu btags pa lta bu ste/ snal ma las gzhan du snam bu med pa ltar cha shas de bzhin rang bzhin nam rgyun la yod pa'i phyir/

dper brjod logs su 'dir ma brjod/ ces pa'i don yin/ gung thang pa bde ba'i blo gros kyis mdzad pa'i 'grel par/ grol ba ni sh+lo ka gcig gis brjod bya skor gcig rdzogs pa'o/ rigs ni sh+lo ka gnyis la sogs pas brjod bya rdzogs pa'o// mdzod ni sh+lo ka gcig gis brjod bya du ma ston pa'o// 'dus pa ni de dag spel ma'am 'dres te 'byung ba'i gsungs te/ rnam grangs so// stag tshang lo chen gyis/ snyan ngag tshigs bcad la yang grol mdzod dus// rim bzhin rkang pa bzhi dang tshigs bcad gcig /tshigs bcad du mas don gcig ston pa'o// zhes gsungs pa ni ci yin cha ma 'tshal lo// gsum pa des brtsams pa'i snyan ngag chen po'i mtshan nyid la bshad par dam bca' ba/ mtshan nyid dngos/ de'i dmigs bsal bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ sargas bcings pa snyan ngag che// de yi mtshan nyid bshad par bya// gong du bshad pa bzhin sarga'am le'u gcig min gyis bcings pa ste/ ngag gi dbang phyug gis ni kha cig sarga bcu drug la sogs pas byas pa chen po nyid du 'dod do zhes dang*/ sarga nye bar mtshan pa yin pas na ā shwā ba dang ang ka dang āt+ma dang gī tis bcings pa'ang snyan ngag chen po'o zhes 'chad de/ don du na skabs du mar bcad pa snyan ngag chen po/ de'i mtshan nyid bshad par bya'o zhes pa'i don yin/ gnyis pa mtshan nyid dngos la/ sgo dang*/ brten gzhi/ rtsom tshul bstan pa dang gsum las/ dang po 'chad par bzhed nas/ shis brjod phyag bya dngos po ni// nges par bstan pa de yi sgo/ de yang gzhung 'di'i shis brjod rgyan 'chad skabs/ mngon par 'dod pa'i dngos po la// smon pa shis pa brjod de dper// ngag yid spyod yul ma yin pa'i// snang ba dam pas khyod la srungs// zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ snyan ngag gi bstan bcos thams cad kyi rgyal po dpag bsam 'khri shing gi dbur/ gang thugs dri bral shel la chags tshon 'dzin pa min pa nyid// yid ni snying rjes brlan la gang gis skyon rnams ma lus skams// gang gis khro ba med la rang gis 'khor ba'i dgra mngon bcom// kun mkhyen de yis khyed la dge legs g.yo ba med gyur cig ces bstan bcos kyi thog mar shis par bya ba'i tshig sbyor 'god pa dang*// sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas su/

rgyal ba thub pa nyi ma ni// snang ba mchog gi bdag nyid can// nang gi mtshan mo shes bral gyi// nang gi nyin byed la phyag 'tshal// zhes pa lta bu bstod yul la phyag bya ba'i tshig 'god pa dang*/ mngon brjod sna tshogs gsal ba las/ de ni phul byung snyan ngag mkhan gyi lam skyes brling pa can// blo yi mig ldan bla mas bstan pa'i mig dang ldan pa yi// sna tshogs snyan ngag mkhan dag gis bkod mngon brjod mdzod rnams las// drangs te mig dang 'dra ba 'di ni sgron me'i mdzod lta bu// zhes bstan bcos kyi lam rnam par gzhag pa'i mig dang mthun par brjod pa dngos po nges bstan te/ rnam pa gsum po de ni bstan bcos kyi sgo yin pas dang por brjod pa yin/ 'o na bstan bcos kyi sgor de gsum ka tshang ba mtha' gcig tu nges par dgos sam zhe na/ ma nges te/ sa paṇ+ḍi tas/ mchod bstod 'dud pa'i bdag nyid can// shis pa brjod sogs mi 'gal te// thams cad du yang ston pa yi// che ba 'ba' zhig ston phyir ro// zhes bstod yul gang yin pa'i che ba brjod pa tsam du gcig pa'i phyir zhes mtha' dpyad// gnyis pa gang la brten pa'i gtam gzhi'i dbang du mdzad nas/ sngon byung gtam las gyur pa'am// cig shos legs pa la brten pa// sde bzhi 'bras bu'i dbang gyur dang*// mkhas shing rgya che'i 'dren pa can// zhes sngon byung ba'i gtam byang chub sems dpa'i skyes pa rabs kyi phreng ba'am/ rig byed las byung ba'i gtam rgyud dam/ 'jig rten la grags pa'i sgrung rgyud sogs sngar byung ba'i gtam ngo mtshar ba dag las gyur zhing*/ sbyar ba'am sngon byung ba'i gtam gyi cig shos te da lta'i gtam brjod par 'os shing legs pa dag kyang brjod byar byas nas de la brten pa'i tshig sbyor 'god la/ sde bzhi ni/ nor gyi sde'am don gyi sde dang*/ 'dod pa'i sde/ chos kyi sde/ thar pa'i sde'o// de la nor ram don gyi sde ni/

rigs pa'i dngos po thos pa la sogs pa dang*/ rdzas kyi dngos po tshong dang rin po che la sogs pa longs spyod brtson pas sgrub cing*/ bsags pa rnams bsrung ba'o// 'dod pa'i sde ni/ ngan 'gro ma yin pa lha mi sogs kyi 'dod pa'i yon tan gyi yul la nye bar spyod pa'o// chos kyi sde ni/ mngon mtho mtho ris gsum dang*/ nges legs byang chub gsum gyi rgyu ste dkar po'i chos mtha' yas pa'o// thar ba'i sde ni/ sdug bsngal rgyu bcas las ldog pa'i theg pa gsum gyi byang chub bo// dang po gnyis 'khor ba'i dbang du byas te/ 'dod pa don du gnyer ba dag de'i rgyur nor sgrub pa dang*/ phyi ma gnyis myang 'das kyi dbang du byas te/ thar pa don gnyer rnams chos bsgrub pa la brtson pa'i phyir ro// 'di bzhi ni skyes bu'i don gyi ngo bo dang*/ bsgrub par bya ba yin pas 'bras bu de dag gi dbang du byas pas na gyur pa dang*/ skyes rabs su 'khor gsum zhes dang*/ yan lag brgyad par/ tshoms gsum med pa'i bya ba la// mi brten de dang 'gal mi bya// zhes pa'ang 'di ste/ thar pa'i tshoms ni chos kyi tshoms su 'du'o zhes 'grel bas 'chad do// gzhan yang*/ rig gnas sgyu rtsal sogs shes bya'i gnas la mkhas shing*/ rigs dang thos pa dang gtong ba sogs yid du 'ong bas yon tan rgya che ba can/ 'dren pa chos srid kyi gtso bo dag gi byung ba brjod pa/ ston pa bde bar gshegs pa'i 'khrungs rabs rtogs brjod rin po che dpag bsam 'khri shing*/ skyes rabs so bzhi pa sogs lta bu'o// 'di skabs zur mkhar ba blo gros rgyal pos/ skyes bu'i lus srog rgyan gsum dper byas nas/ brjod bya sde bzhi'i bsdus pa'i don rnams srog dang*/ rjod byed kyi tshigs bcad lhug spel ma gsum lus dang*/ don rgyan sgra rgyan gab tshig rnams rgyan du bstan pa yin no// 'di lta bu'i 'jog mtshams khong du ma chud par rigs pa gzhan gyis rgyas bkab na bstan bcos chud 'dza' bar 'gyur ro zhes gzhan gyis ma rnyed pa'i legs bshad du sgom par mdzad pa la/

sa lugs mkhan chen byams phrug pas/ lus srog rgyan gsum bshad pa bden nam rdzun// bden na gzhung 'di'i dngos bstan ji lta bu// mi bden na ni lung rigs skyon brjod nas// dpang gyur legs bshad gsar pa sbyin par 'os// zhes klan kar mdzad 'dug pa las 'phros na gzhung 'dir/ lus dang rgyan yang rab tu bstan// gsungs pa dang*/ sa paṇ+ḍi tas/ snyan ngag la ni lus dang rgyan// rnam pa gnyis su bsdus te bshad// ces dang*/ de'i rang 'grel du/ snyan ngag la bsdu na lus dang rgyan gnyis/ lus ni 'dod ba'i don sgrub par byed pa yin la/ rgyan ni mdzes par byed pa'i tshig dang dpe la sogs pa'i sbyor ba khyad par can no zhes so// rgya 'grel gnyis kyi don bsdus pa/ dpang ṭīka tu yang*/ sngon gyi slob dpon de rnams kyis snyan ngag gi lus tshogs pa'i ngo bo dang*/ de mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan yang bstan zhing gsal bar byas so zhes 'byung ba sogs rgya gar mkhas pa'i gsung rgyun can gyi mkhas pa thams cad lus rgyan gnyis las mi bzhed par gsal yang*/ gso rig pa'i bag chags mthu brtas pas/ ji skad du/ srog gi dbang pos ma bzung ba'i// mi ro bzang yang su zhig len// zhes pa lta bur dgongs mod kyi/ shing rta dang*/ shing rta'i rgyan/ gzhal med khang pa dang*/ de'i rgyan zhes pa dang*/ gser gyi ska rags nor bus brgyan pa zhes sogs/ srog dang mi ldan pa'i dngos po du mar rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i rnam gzhag mthong phyin/ skyes bu'i lus srog rgyan gsum kho na dang bstun dgos pa'i nges pa ga la yod/ lus yin phyin srog dgos par nges na mig la sogs pa'i dbang po gzhan yang ci'i phyir mi dgos/ gos med pa'i gcer bu la rgyan yang mi mdzes shing mi 'tshams pas so// ji ltar te/ lus zhes pa'i shugs las srog bstan no snyam na/ rgyan zhes pa'i shugs las gos kyang ci'i phyir mi ston/ des na 'di rigs ha cang dpe la zhen ches pas gtsang du btang bas btsog tu song ba ste/

rgyu mtshan/ spyir snyan ngag ces pa rna bar snyan zhing yid 'phrog pa'i tshig de la gang tshig gi sbyor bas mdzes par bya ba'i yul lam gzhi'am chos can la lus dang*/ de mdzes byed kyi chos tshig gi sbyor ba rnams la rgyan zhes pa'i tha snyad rnam par bzhag pa yang*/ lus ni re zhig 'dod pa yi// don gyi rnam dpyad tshig gi phreng*// zhes dang*/ snyan ngag mdzes par byed pa yi// chos rnams rgyan zhes rab tu brjod// ces pa'i gzhung tshig gong 'og sbrel nas dal bur bklags shing gzhigs pa kho nas rtogs par 'gyur ba'i phyir dang*/ dpang los/ lus sngon la bshad pa ni rgyan gyi rten yin pas so zhes gsungs pas kyang go dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ gzhan du slob dpon paṇ+ḍi ta de yang rtsom pa la mi mkhas pa zhig ste/ lus srog gnyis 'dres 'dres su bshad pas go dka' zhing khyer ma bde ba'i khar/ srog ces pa'i ming tsam zhig sgos dbang gis smos rigs kyang de med pas/ rjes 'jug mgo rmongs par byas snang ba'i phyir na'o// des na sde bzhi sogs spyir lus 'chad pa'i skabs dang*/ bye brag snyan ngag chen po'i mtshan gzhi ngos 'dzin pa dang 'brel ba'i lus las gzhan du dogs par mi rigs sam snyam yang*/ kho bo lta bu ni/ mang du thos kyang dgag sgrub kyi khur len pa'i 'os su mi che bas mkhyen ldan rnams la dpyad par gsol ba'i gzhi tsam du bris par zad do// gsum pa ji ltar rtsom tshul gyi dbang du mdzad nas/ grong khyer rgya mtsho ri dang dus// nyi zla 'char ba'i bsngags pa dang*/ skyed tshal chu yi rol rtsed dang*// chang 'thung dga' ba'i dga' ston dang*// bslu ba dang ni bag ma dang*// gzhon nu skye dang 'phel ba dang*// gros dang pho nya bgrod pa dang*// g.yul dang 'dren pa dar bas kyang*// brgyan par gyur cing*/ 'di la seṅge'i lta stangs kyi tshul gyis grong khyer la sogs dang po lnga la bsngags pa zhes yar blangs te sbyar zhing*/

thams cad la thun mong du brgyan pa zhes bya ba'i tshig sbyar dgos par gsungs pas/ grong khyer gyi bsngags pas brgyan pa ni/ yal 'dab dang por/ gser gyi ba gam gzhal yas khang*// khang pas bskor ba'i grong khyer ni// 'od ldan zhes bya bsod nams las// 'od ldan mtho ris lta bu yod// ces dang*/ gtsug na nor bu'i yal 'dab las/ ba gam 'od tshogs ga bur gyis// yongs su dkar ba'i grong khyer ni// shā ke ta zhes bya ba ste// skal bzang sa yi thig le yod// ces pa lta bu/ rgya mtsho'i bsngags pas brgyan pa ni/ skyes rabs kyi legs par pha rol tu phyin pa'i rabs las/ de ni an+da rnyil gyi mdog ltar sngo// nyi ma'i 'od kyis gnam sngon bzhu ba bzhin// kho ra khor yug mtsho 'gram ltar mi mngon// gting dpag dka' ba'i mtsho 'jing nang du zhugs// zhes dang*/ klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar las/ li shi'i yal 'dab dag ni zos gyur pa'i// lag ldan chu srin sbregs pa'i dri bzang gi /chu dang ldan pa rgya mtsho'i dba' rlabs 'di// rin chen 'od zer dag gis spras te mdzes// zhes pa lta bu yang ngo*// ri bo'i bsngags pas brgyan pa ni/ rgya shug gi gling bgrod kyi yal 'dab las/ rtse mo shin tu mtho ba yi// shel gyi sa 'dzin mdun du mthong*// bya rnams kyis kyang bgrod dka' ba// 'jam pa'i brag ni gcig pu der// zhes dang*/ klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar las/ ston gyi dus kyi chu 'dzin ni// dkar ba'i sgrib byed kyis bsgribs pa// ma la ya yi rtse mo 'di// gangs can ri rtse'i dpal dag 'dzin// zhes pa lta bu/ dus kyi bsngags pas brgyan pa ni/ dpyid la sogs pa ste 'phags skyes po'i yal 'dab las/ de nas yid srubs longs spyod grogs// sbrang rtsi 'thung ba rnams kyi gnyen// skal bzang 'khri shing 'khyud byed pa// legs ldan dpyid ni mthong bar gyur// mdzes ma'i nga rgyal gnyis 'thung dgra

/dpyid ni ral ba ldan pa dag /glal bar byed pa'i lce bzhin du// mya ngan med pa'i dog pa mdzes// gzhon nu'i 'gram pa mdzes pa yi// rkun po tsam+pa ka yi tshogs// mig bzang ma yi skra zhags la// bcing bar 'os pa nyid du gyur// zhes sogs dang*/ dbyar gyi bsngags pa sprin gyi pho nyar byung ba lta bu sogs dus gzhan la'ang shes par bya'o/ nyi zla 'char ba'i bsngags pas brgyan pa ni/ sprin gzhon gyi yal 'dab las/ de nas skya rengs gos dang ldan// brel bas zla ba'i me long zags// dga' ston nye ba la chas bzhin// snang ba ldan pa tho rangs mdzes// pad+mo can gyi dga' ba shar// mtshan mo'i mun pa zhi ba na// 'byung po thams cad bde ba'i slad// mig gi dga' ston dag tu gyur// zhes dang*/ de nas bde sogs mdzes pa yi// rtse dga' gnas pa shar gyi phyogs// zla 'char snang ba nye ba ni// tsan+dan dag gi tshal bzhin mdzes// de nas bdud rtsi bskyed pa ni// longs spyod can gyi longs spyod kyi// skal bzang rtse dga' khyad par can// sngo bsangs gdong gi khyad can shar// zhes sogs lta bu/ skyed mos tshal gyi rol pas brgyan pa ni/ yal 'dab de nyid du/ bung ba'i na chung rnam 'phrul longs spyod ldan// sbrang rtsis myos shing rnam par 'khyams dus der// me tog rab rgyas 'khri shing tshal gyi gzhir// rig 'dzin rgyal po'i sras ni rnam par rgyu// zhes dang*/ klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar las/ 'khri shing khang bzang sa gzhi klu yi brtson pas mu cor 'god byed cing*// me tog rdul gyis gsal bar dga' ston rtags dag gis ni reg gyur te// lhan cig spyod pa dang 'grogs sbrang rtsi'i ro ni rdzogs par 'thung byed pa'i// bung ba 'di dag kun nas chang 'thung longs spyod nyams su byed pa bzhin// sogs lta bu/ chu yi rol rtsed kyis brgyan pa ni/ nor bzang gi yal 'dab las/ de dag dbus su yid 'phrog ma// khrus byas langs pa mthong gyur te// dran pa'i mig gsum me dag ni// zhi byed chu yi lha mo bzhin// lus med rnam 'phrul rtsom pa yi// dba' rlabs tshogs ldan lang tshor ni// gzhon nu ma nyid bying ba yi// rten pa dag ni byed pa bzhin// yid 'ong lha yi gos bgos shing*// ska rags dag ni legs par bcings// chu rtsed rol bas dbu ba yi// phreng ba rab gsal chags pa bzhin// sogs dang*/

'jig rten kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar las/ lhag ma nyal ba bzhin du chu klung rnam spangs lhag ma mthong ba'i phung po las// phyogs kyi glang chen rnams ni rtse zhing sna yis chu 'thor thigs pa'i zer ma rnams// yang dag tshim pa skyes 'gyur chu thigs mu tig 'bras bu'i 'od zer mdzes pa ltar// drang srong bdun po rnams ni gser gyi pad+ma 'dzin cing khrus la rab tu 'jug /ces 'byung ba lta bu/ chang 'thung bas brgyan pa ni/ klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar du/ ha ri tsan+dan gyis byugs lus can lha yi me tog phreng ba rab tu 'dzin// nor bu'i rgyan gyi 'od dag reg pas dwangs shing bkra bar byas pa'i gos dang ldan// grub pa'i skye bo dag dang lhan cig spel bar gyur pa'i rig 'dzin 'di dag rnams// tsan+dan grib bsil dag la dga' ma'i 'thungs lhag tu gyur chang dag 'thung bar byed// ces dang*/ skyes rabs kyi bum pa'i rabs las kyang 'byung ba lta bu'o// dga' ba'i dga' ston gyis brgyan pa ni/ nor bzang gi yal 'dab las/ mchu yi sbrang rtsi chags ldan pa// sbrang rtsi 'thung ba bzhin du des// reg par bzhin gyi chu skyes ni// dud cing pad+mo can de 'dar// smra ba bcad kyang sred pa 'chang*// g.yo ba med kyang yang yang 'dar// skyengs par gyur kyang dpal mdangs gsal// de yi dga' ba de yis bsgrub/ dal gyis mchu yi ro myang zhing*// so yi 'jigs pa byin nas ni// chu skyes rgyas pa'i mig can de'i// smra bcad rgya ni de yis phral// gos mdud 'grol dang dgag pa la// khyo shug lag pa'i pad+ma dag /rab tu 'dar ldan gdu bu'i sgra// rtsod pa byed par gyur pa bzhin// rtse dga' 'dzum gyi me tog rgyas// mdzes pa'i nu ma'i 'bras bus mtshan/ chags bcas yal 'dab ldan pa de'i// longs spyod rkang 'thung spyad byar gyur// ces dang*/ amra skyong ma'i yal 'dab las/ zhes sogs gtam gyi sbyor ba yi// rab dga' yongs rdzogs de dag gis// gang gang 'dod chags kyis brten pa// de de nyams su myong bar gyur// zhes pa lta bu/
